127        public DataForEncounterSide getDataFor(CampaignFleetAPI participantOrCombined) {
128                CampaignFleetAPI combined = battle.getCombinedFor(participantOrCombined);
129                if (combined == null) {
130                        return new DataForEncounterSide(participantOrCombined);
131                }
132                
133                for (DataForEncounterSide curr : sideData) {
134                        if (curr.getFleet() == combined) return curr;
135                }
136                DataForEncounterSide dfes = new DataForEncounterSide(combined);
137                sideData.add(dfes);
138                
139                return dfes;
140        }
141        
142        public DataForEncounterSide getWinnerData() {
143                for (DataForEncounterSide curr : sideData) {
144                        if (!curr.disengaged()) {
145                                return curr;
146                        }
147                }
148                return null;
149        }

151        public DataForEncounterSide getLoserData() {
152                for (DataForEncounterSide curr : sideData) {
153                        if (curr.disengaged()) {
154                                return curr;
155                        }
156                }
157                return null;
158        }

176        protected void updateDeployedMap(EngagementResultForFleetAPI result) {
177                DataForEncounterSide data = getDataFor(result.getFleet());
178                data.getMemberToDeployedMap().clear();
179                
180                List<DeployedFleetMemberAPI> deployed = result.getAllEverDeployedCopy();
181                if (deployed != null && !deployed.isEmpty()) {
182                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm : deployed) {
183                                if (dfm.getMember() != null) {
184                                        FleetMemberAPI member = dfm.getMember();
185                                        data.getMemberToDeployedMap().put(member, dfm);
186                                        
187                                        if (dfm != null && dfm.getShip() != null && dfm.getShip().getOriginalCaptain() != null &&
188                                                        !dfm.getShip().getOriginalCaptain().isDefault()) {
189                                                data.getMembersWithOfficerOrPlayerAsOrigCaptain().add(member);
190                                        }
191                                }
192                        }
193                }
194        }

196        /**
197         * There may be members with no source fleet if they were added to combat
198         * using scripts.
199         * @param result
200         */
201        protected void clearNoSourceMembers(EngagementResultForFleetAPI result) {
202                Iterator<FleetMemberAPI> iter = result.getDeployed().iterator();
203                while (iter.hasNext()) {
204                        FleetMemberAPI member = iter.next();
205                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
206                                iter.remove();
207                        }
208                }
209                iter = result.getReserves().iterator();
210                while (iter.hasNext()) {
211                        FleetMemberAPI member = iter.next();
212                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
213                                iter.remove();
214                        }
215                }
216                iter = result.getDestroyed().iterator();
217                while (iter.hasNext()) {
218                        FleetMemberAPI member = iter.next();
219                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
220                                iter.remove();
221                        }
222                }
223                iter = result.getDisabled().iterator();
224                while (iter.hasNext()) {
225                        FleetMemberAPI member = iter.next();
226                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
227                                iter.remove();
228                        }
229                }
230                iter = result.getRetreated().iterator();
231                while (iter.hasNext()) {
232                        FleetMemberAPI member = iter.next();
233                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
234                                iter.remove();
235                        }
236                }
237        }

247        public void processEngagementResults(EngagementResultAPI result) {
248                engagedInHostilities = true;
249                engagedInActualBattle = true; // whether autoresolve or not, there was actual fighting
250                
251                // the fleets we get back here are combined fleets from the BattleAPI,
252                // NOT the actual fleets involved, even if it's a 1 vs 1 battle.
253                EngagementResultForFleetAPI winnerResult = result.getWinnerResult();
254                EngagementResultForFleetAPI loserResult = result.getLoserResult();
255
256                clearNoSourceMembers(winnerResult);
257                clearNoSourceMembers(loserResult);
258                
259                // only happens for combat where player is involved
260                CombatDamageData currDamageData = result.getLastCombatDamageData();
261                if (currDamageData != null) {
262                        if (runningDamageTotal == null) {
263                                runningDamageTotal = currDamageData;
264                        } else {
265                                runningDamageTotal.add(currDamageData);
266                        }
267                        computeFPHullDamage();
268                }
269                
270                //if (winnerResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet() || loserResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet()) {
271                if (battle.isPlayerInvolved()) {
272                        Global.getSector().reportPlayerEngagement(result);
273                }
274                
275                updateDeployedMap(winnerResult);
276                updateDeployedMap(loserResult);
277
278                //result.applyToFleets();
279                applyResultToFleets(result);
280
281                //if (winnerResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet() && winnerResult.getGoal() != FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
282                if (battle.isPlayerSide(winnerResult) && winnerResult.getGoal() != FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
283                        playerOnlyRetreated = false;
284                        if (loserResult.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
285                                playerPursued = true;
286                        }
287                //} else if (loserResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet() && loserResult.getGoal() != FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
288                } else if (battle.isPlayerSide(loserResult) && loserResult.getGoal() != FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
289                        playerOnlyRetreated = false;
290                        if (winnerResult.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
291                                playerPursued = true;
292                        }
293                }
294                
295                DataForEncounterSide winnerData = getDataFor(winnerResult.getFleet());
296                DataForEncounterSide loserData = getDataFor(loserResult.getFleet());
297                
298                winnerData.setWonLastEngagement(true);
299                winnerData.setEnemyCanCleanDisengage(winnerResult.enemyCanCleanDisengage());
300                //winnerData.setFleetCanCleanDisengage(loserResult.enemyCanCleanDisengage());
301                loserData.setWonLastEngagement(false);
302                loserData.setEnemyCanCleanDisengage(loserResult.enemyCanCleanDisengage());
303                //loserData.setFleetCanCleanDisengage(winnerResult.enemyCanCleanDisengage());
304                
305                winnerData.setDidEnoughToDisengage(true);
306                float damageInFP = 0f;
307                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDisabled()) {
308                        damageInFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
309                }
310                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDestroyed()) {
311                        damageInFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
312                }
313                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getRetreated()) {
314                        damageInFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
315                }
316                
317//              float remaining = 0f;
318//              for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getFleet().getFleetData().getCombatReadyMembersListCopy()) {
319//                      remaining += member.getFleetPointCost();
320//              }
321//              loserData.setDidEnoughToDisengage(damageInFP >= remaining);
322                loserData.setDidEnoughToDisengage(winnerResult.enemyCanCleanDisengage());
323                
324                
325                winnerData.setLastGoal(winnerResult.getGoal());
326                loserData.setLastGoal(loserResult.getGoal());
327                
328                winnerData.getDeployedInLastEngagement().clear();
329                winnerData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement().clear();
330                winnerData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().clear();
331                winnerData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().clear();
332                winnerData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().clear();
333                winnerData.getDeployedInLastEngagement().addAll(winnerResult.getDeployed());
334                winnerData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement().addAll(winnerResult.getRetreated());
335                winnerData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().addAll(winnerResult.getReserves());
336                winnerData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().addAll(winnerResult.getDisabled());
337                winnerData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().addAll(winnerResult.getDestroyed());
338                
339                loserData.getDeployedInLastEngagement().clear();
340                loserData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement().clear();
341                loserData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().clear();
342                loserData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().clear();
343                loserData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().clear();
344                loserData.getDeployedInLastEngagement().addAll(loserResult.getDeployed());
345                loserData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement().addAll(loserResult.getRetreated());
346                loserData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().addAll(loserResult.getReserves());
347                loserData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().addAll(loserResult.getDisabled());
348                loserData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().addAll(loserResult.getDestroyed());
349                
350                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserResult.getDestroyed()) {
351                        loserData.addOwn(member, Status.DESTROYED);
352                }
353                
354                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserResult.getDisabled()) {
355                        loserData.addOwn(member, Status.DISABLED);
356                }
357                
358                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDestroyed()) {
359                        winnerData.addOwn(member, Status.DESTROYED);
360                }
361                
362                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDisabled()) {
363                        winnerData.addOwn(member, Status.DISABLED);
364                }
365                
366                //if (winnerResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet()) {
367                if (result.getWinnerResult().getAllEverDeployedCopy() != null) {
368                        tallyOfficerTime(winnerData, winnerResult);
369                }
370                //} else if (loserResult.getFleet().isPlayerFleet()) {
371                if (result.getLoserResult().getAllEverDeployedCopy() != null) {
372                        tallyOfficerTime(loserData, loserResult);
373                }
374                
375                // important, so that in-combat Ship objects can be garbage collected.
376                // Probably some combat engine references in there, too. 
377                winnerResult.resetAllEverDeployed();
378                getDataFor(winnerResult.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().clear();
379                loserResult.resetAllEverDeployed();
380                getDataFor(loserResult.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().clear();
381                
382                
383                // moved from applyPostEngagementResult
384                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDestroyed()) {
385                        loserData.addEnemy(member, Status.DESTROYED);
386                }
387                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerResult.getDisabled()) {
388                        loserData.addEnemy(member, Status.DISABLED);
389                }
390                
391                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserResult.getDestroyed()) {
392                        winnerData.addEnemy(member, Status.DESTROYED);
393                }
394                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserResult.getDisabled()) {
395                        winnerData.addEnemy(member, Status.DISABLED);
396                }
397                
398                
399                FleetGoal winnerGoal = winnerResult.getGoal();
400                FleetGoal loserGoal = loserResult.getGoal();
401                boolean totalWin = loserData.getFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty();
402                boolean playerOut = result.isPlayerOutBeforeEnd();
403                
404                if (playerOut) {
405                        FleetGoal playerGoal = null;
406                        FleetGoal otherGoal = null;
407                        if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(winnerResult.getFleet()))) {
408                                playerGoal = winnerGoal;
409                                otherGoal = loserGoal;
410                        } else {
411                                playerGoal = loserGoal;
412                                otherGoal = winnerGoal;
413                        }
414                        if (playerGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK) {
415                                if (otherGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK) {
416                                        if (winnerResult.isPlayer()) {
417                                                lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_WIN;
418                                        } else {
419                                                lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_LOSS;
420                                        }
421                                } else {
422                                        if (winnerResult.isPlayer()) {
423                                                lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.PURSUIT_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_WIN;
424                                        } else {
425                                                lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.PURSUIT_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_LOSS;
426                                        }
427                                }
428                        } else {
429                                if (winnerResult.isPlayer()) {
430                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_WIN;
431                                } else {
432                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_OUT_FIRST_LOSS;
433                                }
434                        }
435                } else {
436                        if (totalWin && winnerData.getFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) {
437                                lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.MUTUAL_DESTRUCTION;
438                        } else {
439                                if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(winnerResult.getFleet()))) {
440                                        if (winnerGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK && loserGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK) {
441                                                if (totalWin) {
442                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_PLAYER_WIN_TOTAL;
443                                                } else {
444                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_PLAYER_WIN;
445                                                }
446                                        } else if (winnerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
447                                                if (totalWin) {
448                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_WIN_TOTAL;
449                                                } else {
450                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_WIN;
451                                                }
452                                        } else if (loserGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
453                                                if (totalWin) {
454                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_ENEMY_LOSS_TOTAL;
455                                                } else {
456                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_ENEMY_SUCCESS;
457                                                }
458                                        }
459                                } else {
460                                        if (winnerGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK && loserGoal == FleetGoal.ATTACK) {
461                                                if (totalWin) {
462                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_ENEMY_WIN_TOTAL;
463                                                } else {
464                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.BATTLE_ENEMY_WIN;
465                                                }
466                                        } else if (winnerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
467                                                if (totalWin) {
468                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_ENEMY_WIN_TOTAL;
469                                                } else {
470                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_ENEMY_WIN;
471                                                }
472                                        } else if (loserGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
473                                                if (totalWin) {
474                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_LOSS_TOTAL;
475                                                } else {
476                                                        lastOutcome = EngagementOutcome.ESCAPE_PLAYER_SUCCESS;
477                                                }
478                                        }
479                                }
480                        }
481                }
482                
483                battle.uncombine();
484                //battle.genCombinedDoNotRemoveEmpty();
485                battle.genCombined();
486        }

488        protected void tallyOfficerTime(DataForEncounterSide data, EngagementResultForFleetAPI result) {
489                float maxTime = 0f;
490                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm : result.getAllEverDeployedCopy()) {
491                        float time = dfm.getShip().getFullTimeDeployed();
492                        
493                        if (time > maxTime) {
494                                maxTime = time;
495                        }
496                        
497                        time -= dfm.getShip().getTimeDeployedUnderPlayerControl();
498                        if (time <= 0) continue;
499                        
500                        PersonAPI person = dfm.getMember().getCaptain();
501                        CampaignFleetAPI source = battle.getSourceFleet(dfm.getMember());
502                        if (source == null) continue;
503                        
504                        //if (data.getFleet().getFleetData().getOfficerData(person) == null) {
505                        if (source.getFleetData().getOfficerData(person) == null) {
506                                OfficerEngagementData oed = data.getFleetMemberDeploymentData().get(dfm.getMember());
507                                if (oed == null) {
508                                        oed = new OfficerEngagementData(source);
509                                        oed.person = null;
510                                        data.getFleetMemberDeploymentData().put(dfm.getMember(), oed);
511                                }
512                                time += dfm.getShip().getTimeDeployedUnderPlayerControl();
513                                oed.timeDeployed += time;
514                                continue; // not an officer
515                        }
516                        
517                        OfficerEngagementData oed = data.getOfficerData().get(person);
518                        if (oed == null) {
519                                oed = new OfficerEngagementData(source);
520                                oed.person = person;
521                                data.getOfficerData().put(person, oed);
522                        }
523                        oed.timeDeployed += time;
524                }
525                data.setMaxTimeDeployed(data.getMaxTimeDeployed() + maxTime);
526        }

528        public PursueAvailability getPursuitAvailability(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet) {
529                DataForEncounterSide otherData = getDataFor(otherFleet);
530                
531                if (otherData.isWonLastEngagement()) return PursueAvailability.LOST_LAST_ENGAGEMENT;
532                if (canOutrunOtherFleet(otherFleet, fleet)) return PursueAvailability.TOO_SLOW;
533                if (fleet.getFleetData().getCombatReadyMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) return PursueAvailability.NO_READY_SHIPS;
534                if (otherData.isDidEnoughToDisengage()) return PursueAvailability.TOOK_SERIOUS_LOSSES;
535                return PursueAvailability.AVAILABLE;
536        }
537        
538        public DisengageHarryAvailability getDisengageHarryAvailability(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet) {
539                DataForEncounterSide otherData = getDataFor(otherFleet);
540                if (otherData.isWonLastEngagement()) return DisengageHarryAvailability.LOST_LAST_ENGAGEMENT;
541                if (fleet.getFleetData().getCombatReadyMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) return DisengageHarryAvailability.NO_READY_SHIPS;
542                //if (otherData.isDidEnoughToDisengage()) return DisengageHarryAvailability.LOST_LAST_ENGAGEMENT
543                return DisengageHarryAvailability.AVAILABLE;
544        }

567        public boolean adjustPlayerReputation(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, String ffText, boolean okToAdjustAlly, boolean okToAdjustEnemy) {
568                if (alreadyAdjustedRep) return false;
569                
570                if (battle != null && battle.isPlayerInvolved() && engagedInHostilities) {
571                        alreadyAdjustedRep = true;
572                        
573                        boolean printedAdjustmentText = false;
574                        
575                        boolean playerWon = didPlayerWinMostRecentBattleOfEncounter();
576                        List<CampaignFleetAPI> playerSide = battle.getPlayerSide();
577                        List<CampaignFleetAPI> enemySide = battle.getNonPlayerSide();
578                        
579                        CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
580                        pf.setMoveDestination(pf.getLocation().x, pf.getLocation().y);
581                        
582                        // cases to cover: 1) player destroyed ships 2) player harried/harassed 3) player pursued
583                        // i.e. anything other than a non-destructive retreat, w/o an engagement
584                        boolean playerWasAggressive = playerDidSeriousDamage || !playerOnlyRetreated;
585                        RepActions action = null;
586//                      if (engagedInHostilities) {
587//                              action = RepActions.COMBAT_NO_DAMAGE_ESCAPE;
588//                      }
589                        boolean knowsWhoPlayerIs = battle.knowsWhoPlayerIs(enemySide);
590                        //boolean lowImpact = battle.getNonPlayerCombined().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_LOW_REP_IMPACT) == true;
591                        boolean lowImpact = isLowRepImpact();
592                        if (lowImpact) {
593                                for (CampaignFleetAPI enemy : battle.getSnapshotFor(enemySide)) {
594                                        Misc.makeLowRepImpact(enemy, "battleOnLowImpactSide");
595                                }
596                        }
597                        if (playerPursued && playerWon) {
598                                if (knowsWhoPlayerIs && !lowImpact) {
599                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_AGGRESSIVE;
600                                } else {
601                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_AGGRESSIVE_TOFF;
602                                }
603                        } else if (playerWasAggressive) {
604                                if (knowsWhoPlayerIs && !lowImpact) {
605                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_NORMAL;
606                                } else {
607                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_NORMAL_TOFF;
608                                }
609                        }
610                        
611                        if (isNoRepImpact()) {
612                                action = null;
613                        }
614                        
615                        if (!okToAdjustEnemy) action = null;
616                        
617                        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<String>();
618                        if (action != null) {
619                                // use snapshot: ensure loss of reputation with factions if their fleets were destroyed
620                                for (CampaignFleetAPI enemy : battle.getSnapshotFor(enemySide)) {
621                                        String factionId = enemy.getFaction().getId();
622                                        if (seen.contains(factionId)) continue;
623                                        seen.add(factionId);
624                                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(new RepActionEnvelope(action, null, dialog.getTextPanel()), factionId);
625                                        printedAdjustmentText = true;
626                                }
627                        }
628                        
629                        //if (playerWon) {
630                                action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
631                                float playerFP = 0;
632                                float allyFP = 0;
633                                float enemyFP = 0;
634                                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getSnapshotFor(playerSide)) {
635                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getSnapshot()) {
636                                                if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
637                                                        playerFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
638                                                } else {
639                                                        allyFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
640                                                }
641                                        }
642                                }
643                                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getSnapshotFor(enemySide)) {
644                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getSnapshot()) {
645                                                enemyFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
646                                        }
647                                }
648                                if (allyFP > enemyFP || !playerWon) {
649                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
650                                } else if (allyFP < enemyFP * 0.5f) {
651                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_CRITICAL;
652                                } else {
653                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MAJOR;
654                                }
655                                
656//                              if (playerFPHullDamageToEnemies <= 0) {
657//                                      action = null;
658//                              } else if (playerFPHullDamageToEnemies < allyFPHullDamageToEnemies * 0.1f) {
659//                                      action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
660//                              }
661                                float f = computePlayerContribFraction();
662                                if (f <= 0) {
663                                        action = null;
664                                } else if (f < 0.1f) {
665                                        action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
666                                }
667                                
668                                if (action != null) {
669                                        float totalDam = allyFPHullDamageToEnemies + playerFPHullDamageToEnemies;
670                                        if (totalDam < 10) {
671                                                action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
672                                        } else if (totalDam < 20 && action == RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_CRITICAL) {
673                                                action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MAJOR;
674                                        }
675                                }
676                                
677                                if (battle.isPlayerInvolvedAtStart() && action != null) {
678                                        //action = RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MINOR;
679                                        action = null;
680                                }
681                                
682                                if (!okToAdjustAlly) action = null;
683//                              if (leavingEarly) {
684//                                      action = null;
685//                              }
686                                
687                                // rep increases
688                                seen.clear();
689                                for (CampaignFleetAPI ally : battle.getSnapshotFor(playerSide)) {
690                                        if (ally.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
691                                        
692                                        String factionId = ally.getFaction().getId();
693                                        if (seen.contains(factionId)) continue;
694                                        seen.add(factionId);
695                                        
696                                        Float friendlyFPHull = playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction.get(ally.getFaction());
697                                        float threshold = 2f;
698                                        if (action == RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MAJOR) {
699                                                threshold = 5f;
700                                        } else if (action == RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_CRITICAL) {
701                                                threshold = 10f;
702                                        }
703                                        if (friendlyFPHull != null && friendlyFPHull > threshold) {
704                                                // can lose reputation with sides that didn't survive
705                                                //Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.COMBAT_FRIENDLY_FIRE, (friendlyFPHull - threshold), dialog.getTextPanel()), factionId);
706                                        } else if (action != null && playerSide.contains(ally)) {
707                                                // only gain reputation with factions whose fleets actually survived
708                                                Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(new RepActionEnvelope(action, null, dialog.getTextPanel()), factionId);
709                                                printedAdjustmentText = true;
710                                        }
711                                }
712                                
713                                
714                                // friendly fire rep decreases
715                                if (okToAdjustAlly) {
716                                        boolean first = true;
717                                        seen.clear();
718                                        for (CampaignFleetAPI ally : battle.getSnapshotFor(playerSide)) {
719                                                if (ally.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
720                                                
721                                                String factionId = ally.getFaction().getId();
722                                                if (Factions.PLAYER.equals(factionId)) continue;
723                                                if (seen.contains(factionId)) continue;
724                                                seen.add(factionId);
725                                                
726                                                Float friendlyFPHull = playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction.get(ally.getFaction());
727                                                float threshold = 2f;
728                                                if (action == RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_MAJOR) {
729                                                        threshold = 5f;
730                                                } else if (action == RepActions.COMBAT_HELP_CRITICAL) {
731                                                        threshold = 10f;
732                                                }
733                                                if (friendlyFPHull != null && friendlyFPHull > threshold) {
734                                                        if (first && ffText != null) {
735                                                                first = false;
736                                                                dialog.getTextPanel().addParagraph(ffText);
737                                                        }
738                                                        // can lose reputation with sides that didn't survive
739                                                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.COMBAT_FRIENDLY_FIRE, (friendlyFPHull - threshold), dialog.getTextPanel()), factionId);
740                                                        printedAdjustmentText = true;
741                                                } else if (action != null && playerSide.contains(ally)) {
742                                                        // only gain reputation with factions whose fleets actually survived
743                                                        //Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(new RepActionEnvelope(action, null, dialog.getTextPanel()), factionId);
744                                                }
745                                        }
746                                }
747                        //}
748                        return printedAdjustmentText;
749                }
750                
751                return false;
752        }

772        public void giveOutCombatPay() {
773                int payout = accruedCombatPay;
774                accruedCombatPay = 0;
775                
776                if (payout <= 0) {
777                        return;
778                }
779                
780                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
781                if (fleet == null) {
782                        return;
783                }
784                
785                int credits = (int) fleet.getCargo().getCredits().get();
786                int owed = Math.max(0, payout - credits);
787                if (owed > 0) payout -= owed;
788                
789//              owed = payout;
790//              payout = 0;
791
792                if (payout > 0) {
793                        fleet.getCargo().getCredits().subtract(payout);
794                        if (fleet.getCargo().getCredits().get() < 0) {
795                                fleet.getCargo().getCredits().set(0);
796                        }
797                }
798                
799                if (owed > 0) {
800                        MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
801                        
802                        FDNode backpayNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.FLEET, MonthlyReport.OFFICERS, MonthlyReport.COMBAT_PAY);
803                        backpayNode.name = "Owed combat bonus pay";
804                        backpayNode.custom = MonthlyReport.COMBAT_PAY;
805                        backpayNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
806                        backpayNode.upkeep += owed;
807                }
808                
809                if (textPanelForXPGain != null) {
810                        if (payout > 0) {
811                                textPanelForXPGain.addPara("Combat bonus pay bonuses are distributed among the officers that participated "
812                                                + "in the battle.");
813                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsLossText(payout, textPanelForXPGain);
814                        }
815                        if (owed > 0) {
816                                textPanelForXPGain.addPara("Due to insufficient funds, %s in combat bonus pay is owed to your officers "
817                                                + "and will be added to your monthly expenses.", 
818                                                Misc.getHighlightColor(), Misc.getDGSCredits(owed));
819                        }
820                } else {
821                        if (payout > 0) {
822                                String payStr = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(Math.abs(payout));
823                                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel("Officer combat bonus pay: " + payStr,
824                                                Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), new String[] {payStr},
825                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
826                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
827                        }
828                        if (owed > 0) {
829                                String owedStr = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(Math.abs(owed));
830                                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel("Owed officer combat bonus pay: " + owedStr,
831                                                Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), new String[] {owedStr},
832                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
833                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
834                        }
835                }
836                
837        }

839        public void applyAfterBattleEffectsIfThereWasABattle() {
840                if (!hasWinnerAndLoser() || !engagedInHostilities) {
841                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
842                                member.getStatus().resetAmmoState();
843                        }
844                        
845                        if (noHarryBecauseOfStation && battle != null) {
846                                List<CampaignFleetAPI> otherSide = battle.getNonPlayerSide();
847                                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = battle.getPrimary(otherSide);
848                                if (fleet.getAI() != null && 
849                                                !fleet.getAI().isCurrentAssignment(FleetAssignment.STANDING_DOWN)) {
850                                        fleet.getAI().addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.STANDING_DOWN, fleet, 0.5f + 0.5f * (float) Math.random(), null);
851                                }
852                        }
853                        
854                        //Global.getSector().setLastPlayerBattleTimestamp(Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp());
855                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().setNoEngaging(3f);
856                        return;
857                }
858                
859                gainXP();
860                addPotentialOfficer();
861                giveOutCombatPay();
862                
863//              CampaignFleetAPI winner = getWinnerData().getFleet();
864//              CampaignFleetAPI loser = getLoserData().getFleet();
865//              List<CampaignFleetAPI> winners = battle.getSideFor(getWinnerData().getFleet());
866//              List<CampaignFleetAPI> losers = battle.getSideFor(getLoserData().getFleet());
867                List<CampaignFleetAPI> winners = battle.getSnapshotSideFor(getWinnerData().getFleet());
868                List<CampaignFleetAPI> losers = battle.getSnapshotSideFor(getLoserData().getFleet());
869                if (winners == null || losers == null) return;
870                
871                for (CampaignFleetAPI loser : losers) {
872                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : loser.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
873                                member.getStatus().resetAmmoState();
874                        }
875                        
876                        loser.getVelocity().set(0, 0);
877                        if (loser.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
878                        if (loser.isPlayerFleet()) loser.setNoEngaging(3f);
879                        
880                }
881                for (CampaignFleetAPI winner : winners) {
882                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : winner.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
883                                member.getStatus().resetAmmoState();
884                        }
885                        
886                        winner.getVelocity().set(0, 0);
887                        if (winner.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
888                        if (winner.isPlayerFleet()) winner.setNoEngaging(3f);
889                        
890                }
891                
892                if (battle.isPlayerSide(winners)) {
893                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getPlayerSide()) {
894                                if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
895                                
896                                Misc.forgetAboutTransponder(fleet);
897                        }
898                }
899                
900                battle.setPlayerInvolvementFraction(computePlayerContribFraction());
901                
902                if (!isAutoresolve && engagedInActualBattle) {
903                        Global.getSector().reportBattleOccurred(battle.getPrimary(winners), battle);
904                        Global.getSector().reportBattleFinished(battle.getPrimary(winners), battle);
905                }
906                
907                CampaignFleetAPI largestWinner = battle.getPrimary(winners);
908                for (CampaignFleetAPI loser : losers) {
909                        if (loser.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) {
910                                //Global.getSector().reportFleetDewspawned(loser, FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_FLEET, winner);
911                                loser.despawn(FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE, battle);
912                        }
913                }
914                
915                for (CampaignFleetAPI winner : winners) {
916                        if (winner.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) {
917                                //Global.getSector().reportFleetDewspawned(loser, FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_FLEET, winner);
918                                winner.despawn(FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE, battle);
919                        }
920                }
921                
922                for (CampaignFleetAPI enemy : battle.getBothSides()) {
923                        if (enemy.getAI() instanceof ModularFleetAIAPI) {
924                                ModularFleetAIAPI mAI = (ModularFleetAIAPI) enemy.getAI();
925                                mAI.getTacticalModule().forceTargetReEval();
926                        }
927                }
928
929        }

934        public float performPostVictoryRecovery(EngagementResultAPI result) {
935                EngagementResultForFleetAPI winnerResult = result.getWinnerResult();
936                EngagementResultForFleetAPI loserResult = result.getLoserResult();
937                return performPostVictoryRecovery(winnerResult, loserResult);

939        public float performPostEngagementRecoveryBoth(EngagementResultAPI result) {
940                EngagementResultForFleetAPI winnerResult = result.getWinnerResult();
941                EngagementResultForFleetAPI loserResult = result.getLoserResult();
942                float f = performPostVictoryRecovery(winnerResult, loserResult);
943                f += performPostVictoryRecovery(loserResult, winnerResult);
944                f /= 2f;
945                return f;
946        }
947                
948                
949        public float performPostVictoryRecovery(EngagementResultForFleetAPI winnerResult, EngagementResultForFleetAPI loserResult) {
950                DataForEncounterSide winnerData = getDataFor(winnerResult.getFleet());
951                DataForEncounterSide loserData = getDataFor(loserResult.getFleet());
952                
953                //float totalFpUsed = 0f;
954                float loserDepDestroyed = 0f;
955                float loserDepLeft = 0f;
956                
957                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement()) {
958                        loserDepLeft += member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
959                }
960                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement()) {
961                        loserDepLeft += member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
962                }
963                
964                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement()) {
965                        loserDepDestroyed += member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
966                }
967                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserData.getDisabledInLastEngagement()) {
968                        loserDepDestroyed += member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
969                }
970                for (FleetMemberAPI member : loserData.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement()) {
971                        if (member.isFighterWing()) {
972                                DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(loserData.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
973                                if (dfm != null && dfm.getMember() == member) {
974                                        float deploymentCR = dfm.getShip().getWingCRAtDeployment();
975                                        float finalCR = deploymentCR;
976                                        //float finalCR = dfm.getShip().getRemainingWingCR();
977                                        if (deploymentCR > finalCR) {
978                                                float crPer = dfm.getMember().getStats().getCRPerDeploymentPercent().computeEffective(dfm.getMember().getVariant().getHullSpec().getCRToDeploy()) / 100f;
979                                                float extraCraftLost = (deploymentCR - finalCR) / crPer;
980                                                float wingSize = dfm.getMember().getNumFightersInWing();
981                                                if (extraCraftLost >= 1) {
982                                                        loserDepDestroyed += Math.min(1f, extraCraftLost / wingSize) * member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
983                                                }
984                                        }
985                                }
986                        }
987                }
988
989                float totalRecovery = 0f;
990                float count = 0f;
991                for (FleetMemberAPI member : winnerData.getDeployedInLastEngagement()) {
992                        float dp = member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
993                        float recoveryFraction = Math.max(0, (dp * 1.25f - loserDepDestroyed)) / dp;
994//                      if (member.getFleetData() != null && member.getFleetData().getFleet() != null &&
995//                                      member.getFleetData().getFleet().isPlayerFleet()) {
996                        if (loserDepDestroyed > loserDepLeft * 2f) {
997                                recoveryFraction = Math.max(0, (dp * 0.75f - loserDepDestroyed)) / dp; 
998                        }
999                        if (recoveryFraction > 1f) recoveryFraction = 1f;
1000                        if (loserDepDestroyed <= 0) recoveryFraction = 1f;
1001                        
1002                        float deployCost = getDeployCost(member);
1003                        if (preEngagementCRForWinner.containsKey(member)) {
1004                                float prevCR = preEngagementCRForWinner.get(member);
1005                                if (prevCR < deployCost) {
1006                                        prevCR = deployCost;
1007                                }
1008                        }
1009                        
1010                        float recoveryAmount = Math.round(deployCost * recoveryFraction * 100f) / 100f;
1011                        if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.FULL_CR_RECOVERY)) {
1012                                recoveryAmount = member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR() - member.getRepairTracker().getCR();
1013                        }
1014                        
1015                        totalRecovery += recoveryAmount;
1016                        count++;
1017                        
1018                        if (recoveryAmount <= 0) continue;
1019                        
1020                        
1021                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(recoveryAmount, "Post engagement recovery");
1022                }
1023
1024                if (count <= 0) return 0;
1025                
1026                return Math.round(totalRecovery / count * 100f) / 100f;
1027        }

1297        public BoardingResult boardShip(FleetMemberAPI member, CampaignFleetAPI attacker, CampaignFleetAPI defender) {
1298                
1299                
1300                DataForEncounterSide attackerSide = getDataFor(attacker);
1301                DataForEncounterSide defenderSide = getDataFor(defender);
1302                
1303                float attackerMarineMult = attacker.getCommanderStats().getMarineEffectivnessMult().getModifiedValue();
1304                float defenderMarineMult = defender.getCommanderStats().getMarineEffectivnessMult().getModifiedValue();
1305                
1306                float crewMult = 2f;
1307                float marineMult = 7f;
1308                
1309                
1310                float attackerStr = attacker.getCargo().getMarines() * marineMult;
1311                attackerStr *= attackerMarineMult;
1312                
1313                CrewCompositionAPI defenderCrew = member.getCrewComposition();
1314                float defenderStr = defenderCrew.getCrew() * crewMult + defenderCrew.getMarines() * marineMult;
1315                defenderStr *= defenderMarineMult;
1316
1317                //defenderStr *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("boardingDifficulty");
1318                
1319                Random rand = new Random(1300000 * (member.getId().hashCode() + defender.getId().hashCode() + Global.getSector().getClock().getDay()));
1320                attackerStr *= 0.75f + 0.25f * rand.nextFloat();
1321                defenderStr *= 0.75f + 0.25f * rand.nextFloat();
1322                
1323                boolean attackerWin = attackerStr > defenderStr;
1324                boolean defenderWin = !attackerWin;
1325                
1326                BoardingResult result = new BoardingResult();
1327                result.setMember(member);
1328                
1329                
1330                BoardingOutcome outcome = BoardingOutcome.SUCCESS;
1331                if (defenderWin) {
1332                        outcome = BoardingOutcome.SHIP_ESCAPED;
1333                }
1334                
1335                CrewCompositionAPI boardingParty = Global.getFactory().createCrewComposition();
1336                boardingParty.addMarines(attacker.getCargo().getMarines());
1337                
1338                result.setOutcome(outcome);
1339                switch (outcome) {
1340                case SHIP_ESCAPED:
1341                        computeCrewLossFromBoarding(result, member, boardingParty, attackerStr, defenderStr);
1342                        result.getAttackerLosses().removeFromCargo(attacker.getCargo());
1343                        member.getCrewComposition().removeAll(result.getDefenderLosses());
1344                        
1345                        letBoardableGo(member, defender, attacker);
1346                        break;
1347                case SUCCESS:
1348                        computeCrewLossFromBoarding(result, member, boardingParty, attackerStr, defenderStr);
1349                        result.getAttackerLosses().removeFromCargo(attacker.getCargo());
1350                        member.getCrewComposition().removeAll(result.getDefenderLosses());
1351                        
1352                        //attackerSide.removeEnemyCasualty(member);
1353                        attacker.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
1354                        getBattle().getCombinedFor(attacker).getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
1355                        
1356                        member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(true);
1357                        //defender.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(member);
1358                        
1359                        attackerSide.changeEnemy(member, Status.CAPTURED);
1360                        defenderSide.changeOwn(member, Status.CAPTURED);
1361                        
1362                        attackerSide.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().add(member);
1363                        defenderSide.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1364                        defenderSide.getDisabledInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1365                        
1366                        member.setOwner(0);
1367                        member.setCaptain(Global.getFactory().createPerson());
1368                        break;
1369                }
1370
1371                return result;
1372        }

1374        public float getBoardingSuccessPercent(FleetMemberAPI member, CampaignFleetAPI attacker, CampaignFleetAPI defender) {
1375                DataForEncounterSide attackerSide = getDataFor(attacker);
1376                DataForEncounterSide defenderSide = getDataFor(defender);
1377                float attackerMarineMult = attacker.getCommanderStats().getMarineEffectivnessMult().getModifiedValue();
1378                float defenderMarineMult = defender.getCommanderStats().getMarineEffectivnessMult().getModifiedValue();
1379                
1380                float crewMult = 2f;
1381                float marineMult = 7f;
1382                
1383                Random rand = new Random();
1384                
1385                float wins = 0;
1386                float losses = 0;
1387                
1388                for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
1389                        float attackerStr = attacker.getCargo().getMarines() * marineMult;
1390                        attackerStr *= attackerMarineMult;
1391                        
1392                        CrewCompositionAPI defenderCrew = member.getCrewComposition();
1393                        float defenderStr = defenderCrew.getCrew() * crewMult + defenderCrew.getMarines() * marineMult;
1394                        defenderStr *= defenderMarineMult;
1395        
1396                        //defenderStr *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("boardingDifficulty");
1397                        
1398                        attackerStr *= 0.75f + 0.25f * rand.nextFloat();
1399                        defenderStr *= 0.75f + 0.25f * rand.nextFloat();
1400                
1401                        boolean attackerWin = attackerStr > defenderStr;
1402                        if (attackerWin) wins++;
1403                        else losses++;
1404                }
1405                
1406                return wins;
1407        }

1410        protected void computeMissedLaunchLosses(BoardingResult result, CrewCompositionAPI boardingParty) {
1411                result.getAttackerLosses().addAll(boardingParty);
1412                result.getAttackerLosses().multiplyBy((float) Math.random() * 0.2f);
1413        }
1414        
1415        protected void computeCrewLossFromBoarding(BoardingResult result,
1416                                                        FleetMemberAPI member, CrewCompositionAPI boardingParty,
1417                                                        float attackerStr, float defenderStr) {
1418                
1419                if (attackerStr < 1) attackerStr = 1;
1420                if (defenderStr < 1) defenderStr = 1;
1421                float cap = 2f;
1422                float attackerExtraStr = 0f;
1423                if (attackerStr > defenderStr * cap) {
1424                        attackerExtraStr = attackerStr - defenderStr * cap;  
1425                        attackerStr = defenderStr * cap;
1426                }
1427                if (defenderStr > attackerStr * cap) {
1428                        defenderStr = attackerStr * cap;
1429                }
1430                
1431                float attackerLosses = defenderStr / (attackerStr + defenderStr);
1432                float defenderLosses = attackerStr / (attackerStr + defenderStr);
1433                
1434                if (attackerStr > defenderStr) {
1435                        result.getAttackerLosses().addAll(boardingParty);
1436                        result.getAttackerLosses().multiplyBy(attackerLosses * attackerStr / (attackerExtraStr + attackerStr));
1437                        result.getDefenderLosses().addAll(member.getCrewComposition());
1438                        result.getDefenderLosses().multiplyBy(defenderLosses);
1439                } else {
1440                        result.getAttackerLosses().addAll(boardingParty);
1441                        result.getAttackerLosses().multiplyBy(attackerLosses);
1442                        result.getDefenderLosses().addAll(member.getCrewComposition());
1443                        result.getDefenderLosses().multiplyBy(defenderLosses);
1444                }
1445                //member.getCrewComposition().removeAll(result.getDefenderLosses());
1446        }

1448        public void letBoardableGo(FleetMemberAPI toBoard, CampaignFleetAPI fleetItBelongsTo, CampaignFleetAPI attackingFleet) {
1449                DataForEncounterSide attackerSide = getDataFor(attackingFleet);
1450                attackerSide.removeEnemyCasualty(toBoard);
1451                
1452                DataForEncounterSide defenderSide = getDataFor(fleetItBelongsTo);
1453                defenderSide.removeOwnCasualty(toBoard);
1454                
1455                
1456                defenderSide.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().remove(toBoard);
1457                defenderSide.getDisabledInLastEngagement().remove(toBoard);
1458                defenderSide.getRetreatedFromLastEngagement().add(toBoard);
1459                
1460                if (!fleetItBelongsTo.isValidPlayerFleet()) {
1461                        fleetItBelongsTo.getCargo().removeCrew(fleetItBelongsTo.getCargo().getCrew());
1462                        fleetItBelongsTo.getCargo().removeMarines(fleetItBelongsTo.getCargo().getMarines());
1463                }
1464                
1465                FleetDataAPI data = fleetItBelongsTo.getFleetData();
1466                data.addFleetMember(toBoard);
1467                
1468                getBattle().getCombinedFor(fleetItBelongsTo).getFleetData().addFleetMember(toBoard);
1469                
1470                toBoard.getCrewComposition().addToCargo(fleetItBelongsTo.getCargo());
1471        }

1479        public List<FleetMemberAPI> getRecoverableShips(BattleAPI battle, CampaignFleetAPI winningFleet, CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet) {

1482        public List<FleetMemberAPI> getRecoverableShips(BattleAPI battle, 
1483                                CampaignFleetAPI winningFleet, CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet, boolean playerSideOnly) {
1484                
1485                storyRecoverableShips.clear();
1486                
1487                List<FleetMemberAPI> result = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
1488//              int max = Global.getSettings().getMaxShipsInFleet() - 
1489//                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().size();
1490//              if (Misc.isPlayerOrCombinedContainingPlayer(winningFleet) && max <= 0) {
1491//                      return result;
1492//              }
1493                
1494                if (Misc.isPlayerOrCombinedContainingPlayer(otherFleet)) {
1495                        return result;
1496                }
1497                
1498                DataForEncounterSide winnerData = getDataFor(winningFleet);
1499                DataForEncounterSide loserData = getDataFor(otherFleet);
1500                
1501                float playerContribMult = computePlayerContribFraction();
1502                List<FleetMemberData> enemyCasualties = winnerData.getEnemyCasualties();
1503                List<FleetMemberData> ownCasualties = winnerData.getOwnCasualties();
1504                List<FleetMemberData> all = new ArrayList<FleetMemberData>();
1505                all.addAll(ownCasualties);
1506                Collections.sort(all, new Comparator<FleetMemberData>() {
1507                        public int compare(FleetMemberData o1, FleetMemberData o2) {
1508                                int result = o2.getMember().getVariant().getSMods().size() - o1.getMember().getVariant().getSMods().size();
1509                                if (result == 0) {
1510                                        result = o2.getMember().getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal() - o1.getMember().getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal();
1511                                }
1512                                return result;
1513                        }
1514                });
1515                
1516                
1517                //Random random = Misc.getRandom(battle.getSeed(), 11);
1518                Random random = Misc.getRandom(Global.getSector().getPlayerBattleSeed(), 11);
1519                //System.out.println("BATTLE SEED: " + Global.getSector().getPlayerBattleSeed());
1520                
1521                // since the number of recoverable ships is limited, prefer "better" ships
1522                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberData> enemyPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberData>(random);
1523                
1524                // doesn't matter how it's sorted, as long as it's consistent so that
1525                // the order it's insertied into the picker in is the same
1526                List<FleetMemberData> enemy = new ArrayList<FleetMemberData>(enemyCasualties);
1527                Collections.sort(enemy, new Comparator<FleetMemberData>() {
1528                        public int compare(FleetMemberData o1, FleetMemberData o2) {
1529                                int result = o2.getMember().getId().hashCode() - o1.getMember().getId().hashCode();
1530                                return result;
1531                        }
1532                });
1533                
1534                for (FleetMemberData curr : enemy) {
1535                        float base = 10f;
1536                        switch (curr.getMember().getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
1537                        case CAPITAL_SHIP: base = 40f; break;
1538                        case CRUISER: base = 20f; break;
1539                        case DESTROYER: base = 10f; break;
1540                        case FRIGATE: base = 5f; break;
1541                        }
1542                        float w = curr.getMember().getUnmodifiedDeploymentPointsCost() / base;
1543                        
1544                        enemyPicker.add(curr, w);
1545                }
1546                List<FleetMemberData> sortedEnemy = new ArrayList<FleetMemberData>();
1547                while (!enemyPicker.isEmpty()) {
1548                        sortedEnemy.add(enemyPicker.pickAndRemove());
1549                }
1550                
1551                if (!playerSideOnly) {
1552                        all.addAll(sortedEnemy);
1553                }
1554                
1555//              for (FleetMemberData curr : all) {
1556//                      System.out.println(curr.getMember().getHullId());
1557//              }
1558                
1559                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
1560                
1561                int maxRecoverablePerType = Global.getSettings().getInt("maxRecoverableShipsNormalOrStory");
1562                
1563                float probLessDModsOnNext = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseProbLessDModsOnRecoverableEnemyShip");
1564                float lessDmodsOnNextMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("lessDModsOnRecoverableEnemyShipMultNext");
1565                
1566                float recFraction = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipRecoverableFraction") : 1f;
1567                
1568                int count = 0;
1569                for (FleetMemberData data : all) {
1570//                      if (data.getMember().getHullId().contains("legion")) {
1571//                              System.out.println("wefwefwefe");
1572//                      }
1573                        //if (data.getMember().getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.UNBOARDABLE)) continue;
1574                        if (Misc.isUnboardable(data.getMember())) continue;
1575                        if (data.getStatus() != Status.DISABLED && data.getStatus() != Status.DESTROYED) continue;
1576
1577                        boolean own = ownCasualties.contains(data);
1578                        if (own && data.getMember().isAlly()) continue;
1579
1580//                      if (data.getMember().getHullId().startsWith("vanguard_pirates")) {
1581//                              System.out.println("wefwefwefe12341234");
1582//                      }
1583                        
1584                        float mult = 1f;
1585                        if (data.getStatus() == Status.DESTROYED) mult = 0.5f;
1586                        if (!own) mult *= playerContribMult;
1587                        
1588                        
1589                        boolean useOfficerRecovery = false;
1590                        if (own) {
1591                                useOfficerRecovery = winnerData.getMembersWithOfficerOrPlayerAsOrigCaptain().contains(data.getMember());
1592                                if (useOfficerRecovery) {
1593                                        mult = 1f;
1594                                }
1595                        }
1596                        
1597                        boolean noRecovery = false;
1598                        if (battle != null &&
1599                                battle.getSourceFleet(data.getMember()) != null) {
1600                                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = battle.getSourceFleet(data.getMember());
1601                                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_RECOVERY)) {
1602                                        noRecovery = true;
1603                                }
1604                        }
1605                        
1606                        boolean alwaysRec = data.getMember().getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALWAYS_RECOVERABLE);
1607        
1608                        if (!own && !alwaysRec && random.nextFloat() >= recFraction) {
1609                                noRecovery = true;

1638                        }
1639                        
1640                        
1641                        //if (true || Misc.isShipRecoverable(data.getMember(), playerFleet, own, useOfficerRecovery, battle.getSeed(), 1f * mult)) {

1759        public static void recoverShips(List<FleetMemberAPI> ships, FleetEncounterContext context, CampaignFleetAPI winningFleet, CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet) {
1760                
1761                if (!Misc.isPlayerOrCombinedContainingPlayer(winningFleet)) {
1762                        return;
1763                }
1764                
1765                DataForEncounterSide winnerData = null;
1766                DataForEncounterSide loserData = null;
1767                
1768                if (context != null) {
1769                        winnerData = context.getDataFor(winningFleet);
1770                        loserData = context.getDataFor(otherFleet);
1771                }
1772                
1773                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
1774                
1775                for (FleetMemberAPI member : ships) {
1776                        //CampaignFleetAPI sourceFleet = context.getBattle().getSourceFleet(member);
1777                        //repairFleetMember(member, sourceFleet == playerFleet);
1778                        
1779                        if (member.getStatus().getNumStatuses() <= 1) {
1780                                member.getStatus().repairDisabledABit();
1781                        }
1782//                      for (int i = 1; i < member.getStatus().getNumStatuses(); i++) {
1783//                              if ((float) Math.random() > 0.33f) {
1784//                                      member.getStatus().setDetached(i, true);
1785//                                      member.getStatus().setHullFraction(i, 0f);
1786//                              }
1787//                      }
1788                        
1789                        float minHull = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MIN, 0f);
1790                        float maxHull = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MAX, 0f);
1791                        float minCR = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MIN, 0f);
1792                        float maxCR = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MAX, 0f);
1793                        
1794                        minHull += member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MIN, 0f);
1795                        maxHull += member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MAX, 0f);
1796                        minCR += member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MIN, 0f);
1797                        maxCR += member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MAX, 0f);
1798                        
1799                        float hull = (float) Math.random() * (maxHull - minHull) + minHull;
1800                        if (hull < 0.01f) hull = 0.01f;
1801                        if (hull > 1f) hull = 1f;
1802                        member.getStatus().setHullFraction(hull);
1803                        
1804                        float cr = (float) Math.random() * (maxCR - minCR) + minCR;
1805                        if (cr < 0 || member.isMothballed()) cr = 0;
1806                        float max = member.getRepairTracker() == null ? 1f : member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR();
1807                        if (context != null) {
1808                                max = Math.min(max, member.getRepairTracker().getCrWhenDisabledOrDestroyed() - getDeployCost(member));
1809                                if (max < 0f) max = 0f;
1810                        }
1811                        if (cr > max) cr = max;
1812                        if (cr > 0) {
1813                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(cr, "effective ship recovery procedures");       
1814                        } else {
1815                                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(cr);
1816                        }
1817                        
1818                        if (winnerData != null) winnerData.getInReserveDuringLastEngagement().add(member);
1819                        playerFleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
1820                        if (context != null) {
1821                                context.getBattle().getCombinedFor(playerFleet).getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
1822                                context.origSourceForRecoveredShips.put(member, context.getBattle().getSourceFleet(member));
1823                                context.getBattle().getMemberSourceMap().put(member, playerFleet);
1824                        }
1825                        
1826                        member.setFleetCommanderForStats(null, null);
1827                        
1828
1829                        member.setOwner(0);
1830                        
1831                        if (!Misc.isUnremovable(member.getCaptain())) {
1832                                member.setCaptain(Global.getFactory().createPerson());
1833                                member.getCaptain().setFaction(Factions.PLAYER);
1834                        }
1835                        
1836                        //member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(true);
1837                        
1838                        if (winnerData != null) {
1839                                winnerData.changeEnemy(member, Status.REPAIRED);
1840                                winnerData.changeOwn(member, Status.REPAIRED);
1841                                
1842                                winnerData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1843                                winnerData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1844                        }
1845                        
1846                        if (loserData != null) {
1847                                loserData.changeEnemy(member, Status.REPAIRED);
1848                                loserData.changeOwn(member, Status.REPAIRED);
1849                                
1850                                loserData.getDestroyedInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1851                                loserData.getDisabledInLastEngagement().remove(member);
1852                        }
1853                }
1854
1855                return;
1856        }
