1859        public static void prepareShipForRecovery(FleetMemberAPI member,
1860                                        boolean retainAllHullmods, boolean retainKnownHullmods, boolean clearSMods,
1861                                        float weaponRetainProb, float wingRetainProb, Random salvageRandom) {
1862                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant().clone();
1863                //variant.setOriginalVariant(null);
1864                if (retainAllHullmods) {
1865                        // do nothing
1866                } else if (retainKnownHullmods) {
1867                        for (String modId : new ArrayList<String>(variant.getHullMods())) {
1868                                if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(modId)) {
1869                                        variant.removeMod(modId);
1870                                }
1871                        }
1872                } else {
1873                        variant.clearHullMods();
1874                        variant.setNumFluxCapacitors(0);
1875                        variant.setNumFluxVents(0);
1876                }
1877                
1878                if (clearSMods && !variant.hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALWAYS_RETAIN_SMODS_ON_SALVAGE)) {
1879                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(variant.getSMods())) {
1880                                variant.removePermaMod(id);
1881                        }
1882                }
1883                
1884                variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
1885                member.setVariant(variant, false, false);
1886                List<String> remove = new ArrayList<String>();
1887                
1888//              if (!retainHullmods) {
1889//                      variant.clearHullMods();
1890//                      variant.setNumFluxCapacitors(0);
1891//                      variant.setNumFluxVents(0);
1892//              }
1893                
1894                Random random = new Random();
1895                if (salvageRandom != null) random = salvageRandom;
1896                
1897                if (!member.isFighterWing()) {
1898                        for (String slotId : variant.getNonBuiltInWeaponSlots()) {
1899                                if (random.nextFloat() > weaponRetainProb) {
1900                                        remove.add(slotId);
1901                                }
1902                        }
1903                        for (String slotId : remove) {
1904                                variant.clearSlot(slotId);
1905                        }
1906                        
1907                        int index = 0;
1908                        for (String id : variant.getFittedWings()) {
1909                                if (random.nextFloat() > wingRetainProb) {
1910                                        variant.setWingId(index, null); // won't clear out built-in wings
1911                                }
1912                                index++;
1913                        }
1914                }
1915                
1916                for (String slotId : variant.getStationModules().keySet()) {
1917                        prepareModuleForRecovery(member, slotId, 
1918                                        retainAllHullmods, retainKnownHullmods, clearSMods, weaponRetainProb, wingRetainProb, salvageRandom);
1919                }
1920                
1921                
1922                for (int i = 1; i < member.getStatus().getNumStatuses(); i++) {
1923                        if (random.nextFloat() > 0.5f) {
1924                                member.getStatus().setDetached(i, false);
1925                                member.getStatus().setHullFraction(i, 0.1f + 0.1f * random.nextFloat());
1926                        }
1927                }
1928        
1929                // get rid of any short-term modifiers, such as "0 repair rate during emergency burn"
1930                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
1931                        member.getBuffManager().advance(1f);
1932                }
1933//              for (Buff buff : new ArrayList<Buff>(member.getBuffManager().getBuffs())) {
1934//                      member.getBuffManager().removeBuff(buff.getId());
1935//              }
1936                
1937                variant.addTag(Tags.SHIP_RECOVERABLE);
1938        }

1940        public static void prepareModuleForRecovery(FleetMemberAPI member, String moduleSlotId,
1941                        boolean retainAllHullmods, boolean retainKnownHullmods, boolean clearSMods,
1942                        float weaponRetainProb, float wingRetainProb, Random salvageRandom) {
1943                
1944                ShipVariantAPI moduleCurrent = member.getVariant().getModuleVariant(moduleSlotId);
1945                if (moduleCurrent == null) return;

1947                moduleCurrent = moduleCurrent.clone();
1948                moduleCurrent.setOriginalVariant(null);

1950                        // do nothing
1951                } else if (retainKnownHullmods) {
1952                        for (String modId : new ArrayList<String>(moduleCurrent.getHullMods())) {
1953                                if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(modId)) {
1954                                        moduleCurrent.removeMod(modId);
1955                                }
1956                        }
1957                } else {
1958                        moduleCurrent.clearHullMods();
1959                        moduleCurrent.setNumFluxCapacitors(0);
1960                        moduleCurrent.setNumFluxVents(0);
1961                }
1962                
1963                if (clearSMods && !moduleCurrent.hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALWAYS_RETAIN_SMODS_ON_SALVAGE)) {
1964                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(moduleCurrent.getSMods())) {
1965                                moduleCurrent.removePermaMod(id);
1966                        }
1967                }
1968                
1969                moduleCurrent.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
1970                member.getVariant().setModuleVariant(moduleSlotId, moduleCurrent);
1971                
1972                List<String> remove = new ArrayList<String>();
1973
1974                Random random = Misc.random;
1975                if (salvageRandom != null) random = salvageRandom;
1976
1977                for (String slotId : moduleCurrent.getNonBuiltInWeaponSlots()) {
1978                        if (random.nextFloat() > weaponRetainProb) {
1979                                remove.add(slotId);
1980                        }
1981                }
1982                for (String slotId : remove) {
1983                        moduleCurrent.clearSlot(slotId);
1984                }
1985
1986                int index = 0;
1987                for (String id : moduleCurrent.getFittedWings()) {
1988                        if (random.nextFloat() > wingRetainProb) {
1989                                moduleCurrent.setWingId(index, null); // won't clear out built-in wings
1990                        }
1991                        index++;
1992                }
1993        }

1996        public void gainXP() {
1997                if (sideData.size() != 2) return;
1998                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
1999
2000                DataForEncounterSide sideOne = sideData.get(0);
2001                DataForEncounterSide sideTwo = sideData.get(1);
2002                if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(sideOne.getFleet()))) {
2003                        gainXP(sideOne, sideTwo);
2004                } else if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(sideTwo.getFleet()))) {
2005                        gainXP(sideTwo, sideOne);
2006                }
2007        }

2009        protected void gainOfficerXP(DataForEncounterSide data, float xp) {
2010                float max = data.getMaxTimeDeployed();
2011                if (max < 1) max = 1;
2012                float num = data.getOfficerData().size();
2013                if (num < 1) num = 1;
2014                for (PersonAPI person : data.getOfficerData().keySet()) {
2015                        OfficerEngagementData oed = data.getOfficerData().get(person);
2016                        if (oed.sourceFleet == null || !oed.sourceFleet.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
2017                        
2018                        OfficerDataAPI od = oed.sourceFleet.getFleetData().getOfficerData(person);
2019                        if (od == null) continue; // shouldn't happen, as this is checked earlier before it goes into the map
2020                        
2021                        float f = oed.timeDeployed / max;
2022                        if (f < 0) f = 0;
2023                        if (f > 1) f = 1;
2024                        
2025                        od.addXP((long)(f * xp / num), textPanelForXPGain);
2026                }
2027        }

2031                return playerFPHullDamageToEnemies;

2034        public void setPlayerFPHullDamageToEnemies(float playerFPHullDamageToEnemies) {

2045
2046        protected float playerFPHullDamageToEnemies = 0f;
2047        protected float allyFPHullDamageToEnemies = 0f;
2048        protected float playerFPHullDamageToAllies = 0f;
2049        protected Map<FactionAPI, Float> playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction = new HashMap<FactionAPI, Float>();
2050        protected void computeFPHullDamage() {
2051                if (runningDamageTotal == null) return;
2052                
2053//              playerFPHullDamageToEnemies = 0f;
2054//              allyFPHullDamageToEnemies = 0f;
2055//              playerFPHullDamageToAllies = 0f;
2056                
2057                for (FleetMemberAPI member : runningDamageTotal.getDealt().keySet()) {
2058                        if (member.getOwner() != 0) continue;
2059                        
2060                        
2061                        DealtByFleetMember dealt = runningDamageTotal.getDealt().get(member);
2062                        for (FleetMemberAPI target : dealt.getDamage().keySet()) {
2063                                if (battle.getSourceFleet(target) == null) continue;
2064                                
2065                                DamageToFleetMember damage = dealt.getDamageTo(target);
2066                                float maxHull = target.getStats().getHullBonus().computeEffective(target.getHullSpec().getHitpoints());
2067                                if (maxHull <= 0) continue;
2068                                if (target.isFighterWing()) {
2069                                        maxHull *= target.getNumFightersInWing();
2070                                }
2071                                
2072                                float currDam = Math.min(damage.hullDamage, maxHull) / maxHull * (float) target.getFleetPointCost();
2073                                if (target.getOwner() == 1) {
2074                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = battle != null ? battle.getSourceFleet(member) : null;
2075                                        boolean ally = member.isAlly();
2076                                        if (ally && fleet != null && 
2077                                                        fleet.getFaction() != null && fleet.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) {
2078                                                ally = false;
2079                                        }
2080                                        if (ally) {
2081                                                allyFPHullDamageToEnemies += currDam;
2082                                        } else {
2083                                                playerFPHullDamageToEnemies += currDam;
2084                                        }
2085                                } else if (!member.isAlly() && target.isAlly() && !target.isFighterWing()) {
2086                                        playerFPHullDamageToAllies += currDam;
2087                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = battle != null ? battle.getSourceFleet(target) : null;
2088                                        if (fleet != null) {
2089                                                float curr = currDam;
2090                                                if (playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction.containsKey(fleet.getFaction())) {
2091                                                        curr += playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction.get(fleet.getFaction());
2092                                                }
2093                                                playerFPHullDamageToAlliesByFaction.put(fleet.getFaction(), curr);
2094                                        }
2095                                }
2096                        }
2097                }
2098                
2099//              if (playerFPHullDamageToEnemies <= 0) {
2100//                      System.out.println("HERE 12523423");
2101//              }
2102//              allyFPHullDamageToEnemies += playerFPHullDamageToEnemies;
2103//              playerFPHullDamageToEnemies = 0f;
2104                runningDamageTotal = null;
2105        }

2107        
2108        public float computePlayerContribFraction() {
2109                float total = playerFPHullDamageToEnemies + allyFPHullDamageToEnemies;
2110                if (total <= 0) {
2111                        if (battle == null) return 1f;
2112                        if (battle.isPlayerInvolved() && (battle.getPlayerSideSnapshot().size() <= 1 || battle.getPlayerSide().size() <= 1)) return 1f;
2113                        return 0f;
2114                }
2115                
2116                boolean hasAllies = false;
2117                boolean startedWithAllies = false;
2118                if (battle != null) {
2119                        hasAllies = battle.getPlayerSide().size() <= 1;
2120                        startedWithAllies = battle.getPlayerSideSnapshot().size() > 1;
2121                }
2122                if (startedWithAllies) { // && hasAllies) {
2123                        //return Math.min(0.9f, playerFPHullDamageToEnemies / total);
2124                        return Math.min(1f, playerFPHullDamageToEnemies / total);
2125                } else {
2126                        return 1f;
2127                }
2128        }

2131        protected void gainXP(DataForEncounterSide side, DataForEncounterSide otherSide) {
2132                float bonusXP = 0f;
2133                float points = 0f;
2134                for (FleetMemberData data : side.getOwnCasualties()) {
2135                        if (data.getStatus() == Status.DISABLED || 
2136                                        data.getStatus() == Status.DESTROYED) {
2137                                float [] bonus = Misc.getBonusXPForScuttling(data.getMember());
2138                                points += bonus[0];
2139                                bonusXP += bonus[1] * bonus[0];
2140                        }
2141                }
2142                if (bonusXP > 0 && points > 0) {
2143                        points = 1;
2144                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().setOnlyAddBonusXPDoNotSpendStoryPoints(true);
2145                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().setBonusXPGainReason("from losing s-modded ships");
2146                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().spendStoryPoints((int)Math.round(points), true, textPanelForXPGain, false, bonusXP, null);
2147                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().setOnlyAddBonusXPDoNotSpendStoryPoints(false);
2148                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().setBonusXPGainReason(null);
2149                }
2150                
2151                //CampaignFleetAPI fleet = side.getFleet();
2152                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
2153                float fpTotal = 0;
2154                for (FleetMemberData data : otherSide.getOwnCasualties()) {
2155                        float fp = data.getMember().getFleetPointCost();
2156                        
2157//                      String prefix = "xp_mult_";
2158//                      for (String tag : data.getMember().getHullSpec().getTags()) {
2159//                              if (tag.startsWith(prefix)) {
2160//                                      tag = tag.replaceFirst(prefix, "");
2161//                                      fp *= Float.parseFloat(tag);
2162//                                      break;
2163//                              }
2164//                      }
2165                        
2166                        fp *= 1f + data.getMember().getCaptain().getStats().getLevel() / 5f;
2167                        fpTotal += fp;
2168                }
2169                
2170                float xp = (float) fpTotal * 250;
2171                xp *= 2f;
2172                
2173                float difficultyMult = Math.max(1f, difficulty);
2174                xp *= difficultyMult;
2175                
2176                xp *= computePlayerContribFraction();
2177                
2178                xp *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("xpGainMult");
2179                
2180                
2181                if (xp > 0) {
2182                        //fleet.getCargo().gainCrewXP(xp);
2183                        
2184                        //if (side.getFleet().isPlayerFleet()) {
2185                        //}
2186                        // only gain XP if it's the player fleet anyway, no need to check this here
2187                        gainOfficerXP(side, xp);
2188                        
2189                        fleet.getCommander().getStats().addXP((long) xp, textPanelForXPGain);
2190                        fleet.getCommander().getStats().levelUpIfNeeded(textPanelForXPGain);
2191                        
2192                        xpGained = xp;
2193                }
2194        }

2196        public void addPotentialOfficer() {
2197                if (!isEngagedInHostilities()) return;
2198                if (xpGained <= 0) return;
2199                if (sideData.size() != 2) return;
2200                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
2201
2202                DataForEncounterSide sideOne = sideData.get(0);
2203                DataForEncounterSide sideTwo = sideData.get(1);
2204                
2205                DataForEncounterSide player = sideOne;
2206                DataForEncounterSide enemy = sideTwo;
2207                if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(sideTwo.getFleet()))) {
2208                        player = sideTwo;
2209                        enemy = sideOne;
2210                }
2211                
2212                float fpDestroyed = 0;
2213                for (FleetMemberData data : enemy.getOwnCasualties()) {
2214                        float fp = data.getMember().getFleetPointCost();
2215                        fp *= 1f + data.getMember().getCaptain().getStats().getLevel() / 5f;
2216                        fpDestroyed += fp;
2217                }
2218                fpDestroyed *= computePlayerContribFraction();
2219                for (FleetMemberData data : player.getOwnCasualties()) {
2220                        if (data.getMember().isAlly()) continue;
2221                        float fp = data.getMember().getFleetPointCost();
2222                        fp *= 1f + data.getMember().getCaptain().getStats().getLevel() / 5f;
2223                        fpDestroyed += fp;
2224                }
2225                
2226                float fpInFleet = 0f;
2227                for (FleetMemberAPI member : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
2228                        float fp = member.getFleetPointCost();
2229                        fp *= 1f + member.getCaptain().getStats().getLevel() / 5f;
2230                        fpInFleet += fp;
2231                }
2232                
2233                
2234                float maxProb = Global.getSettings().getFloat("maxOfficerPromoteProb");
2235                float probMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerPromoteProbMult");
2236                int max = Misc.getMaxOfficers(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
2237                int curr = Misc.getNumNonMercOfficers(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
2238                if (max < 1) max = 1;
2239                if (curr > max) curr = max;
2240                
2241                float prob = fpDestroyed / (Math.max(1f, fpInFleet));
2242                prob = (0.2f + 0.8f * (1f - (float) curr / (float) max)) * prob;
2243                //prob /= 5f;
2244                prob *= probMult;
2245                
2246                if (curr >= max) prob *= 0.5f;
2247                if (prob > maxProb) prob = maxProb;
2248                
2249                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
2250                        prob *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_officersAvailableFraction");
2251                }
2252                
2253                Random random = Misc.random;
2254                if (salvageRandom != null) {
2255                        random = salvageRandom;
2256                }
2257                
2258                if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) {
2259                        prob = 0f;
2260                }
2261                
2262                if (random.nextFloat() < prob) {
2263                        PromoteOfficerIntel intel = new PromoteOfficerIntel(textPanelForXPGain);
2264                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, false, textPanelForXPGain);
2265                }
2266        }

2291        protected void generatePlayerLoot(List<FleetMemberAPI> recoveredShips, boolean withCredits) {
2292                //computeFPHullDamage();
2293                
2294                
2295                DataForEncounterSide winner = getWinnerData();
2296                DataForEncounterSide loser = getLoserData();
2297
2298                if (winner == null || loser == null) return;
2299        
2300                float adjustedFPSalvage = 0;
2301                float playerContribMult = computePlayerContribFraction();
2302                
2303                Random origSalvageRandom = salvageRandom;
2304                long extraSeed = 1340234324325L;
2305                if (origSalvageRandom != null) extraSeed = origSalvageRandom.nextLong();
2306                
2307                float wepMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_weaponDropFraction") : 1f;
2308                float fighterMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_fighterDropFraction") : 1f;
2309                float hullmodMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_hullmodDropFraction") : 1f;
2310                
2311                for (FleetMemberData data : winner.getEnemyCasualties()) {
2312                        if (data.getStatus() == Status.REPAIRED) {
2313                                continue;
2314                        }
2315                        
2316                        if (data.getMember() != null && data.getMember().getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_BATTLE_SALVAGE)) {
2317                                continue;
2318                        }
2319                        
2320                        if (origSalvageRandom != null) {
2321                                String sig = data.getMember().getHullId();
2322                                if (data.getMember().getVariant() != null) {
2323                                        for (WeaponGroupSpec spec : data.getMember().getVariant().getWeaponGroups()) {
2324                                                for (String slotId : spec.getSlots()) {
2325                                                        String w = data.getMember().getVariant().getWeaponId(slotId);
2326                                                        if (w != null) sig += w;
2327                                                }
2328                                        }
2329                                }
2330                                if (loser != null && loser.getFleet() != null && loser.getFleet().getFleetData() != null) {
2331                                        List<FleetMemberAPI> members = loser.getFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
2332                                        if (members != null) {
2333                                                int index = members.indexOf(data.getMember());
2334                                                if (index >= 0) {
2335                                                        sig += "" + index;
2336                                                }
2337                                        }
2338                                }
2339                                long seed = sig.hashCode() * 143234234234L * extraSeed;
2340                                salvageRandom = new Random(seed);
2341                                //System.out.println("Seed for " + data.getMember() + ": " + seed);
2342                        }
2343                        
2344                        float mult = getSalvageMult(data.getStatus()) * playerContribMult;
2345                        lootWeapons(data.getMember(), data.getMember().getVariant(), false, mult * wepMult, false);
2346                        lootHullMods(data.getMember(), data.getMember().getVariant(), mult * hullmodMult);
2347                        lootWings(data.getMember(), data.getMember().getVariant(), false, mult * fighterMult);
2348                        
2349                        mult *= getSalvageResourceMult(data);
2350                        adjustedFPSalvage += (float) data.getMember().getFleetPointCost() * mult;
2351                }
2352                
2353                for (FleetMemberData data : winner.getOwnCasualties()) {
2354                        if (data.getMember().isAlly()) continue;
2355                        
2356                        if (data.getStatus() == Status.CAPTURED || data.getStatus() == Status.REPAIRED) {
2357                                continue;
2358                        }
2359                        
2360                        if (data.getMember() != null && data.getMember().getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_BATTLE_SALVAGE)) {
2361                                continue;
2362                        }
2363                        
2364                        // only care about salvageRandom for enemy casualties, not player
2365//                      if (origSalvageRandom != null) {
2366//                              salvageRandom = new Random(data.getMember().getId().hashCode() * 143234234234L * extraSeed);
2367//                      }
2368                        
2369                        float mult = getSalvageMult(data.getStatus());
2370                        lootWeapons(data.getMember(), data.getMember().getVariant(), true, mult, false);
2371                        lootWings(data.getMember(), data.getMember().getVariant(), true, mult);
2372                        
2373                        mult *= getSalvageResourceMult(data);
2374                        adjustedFPSalvage += (float) data.getMember().getFleetPointCost() * mult;
2375                }
2376                
2377                if (recoveredShips != null) {
2378                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : recoveredShips) {
2379                                float mult = getSalvageMult(Status.CAPTURED);
2380                                mult *= getSalvageResourceMult(member);
2381                                adjustedFPSalvage += (float) member.getFleetPointCost() * mult;
2382                        }
2383                }
2384                
2385                salvageRandom = origSalvageRandom;
2386                
2387                // don't want salvageRandom to be influenced by the number of losses on either side
2388                Random resetSalvageRandomTo = null;
2389                Random forRandomDrops = null;
2390                Random forCargoDrops = null;
2391
2392                Random random = Misc.random;
2393                if (salvageRandom != null) {
2394                        random = salvageRandom;
2395                        resetSalvageRandomTo = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 11);
2396                        forRandomDrops = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 17);
2397                        forCargoDrops = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 31);
2398                } else {
2399                        if (getBattle() != null) {
2400                                MemoryAPI memory = getBattle().getNonPlayerCombined().getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
2401                                if (memory.contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED)) {
2402                                        random = new Random(memory.getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED));
2403                                }
2404                        }
2405                }
2406                
2407                float minCreditsFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageFractionCreditsMin");
2408                float maxCreditsFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageFractionCreditsMax");
2409                
2410                float creditsFraction = minCreditsFraction + (maxCreditsFraction - minCreditsFraction) * random.nextFloat();
2411                creditsFraction *= playerContribMult;
2412                
2413                float maxSalvageValue = adjustedFPSalvage * Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageValuePerFP");
2414                if (Misc.isEasy()) {
2415                         maxSalvageValue *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("easySalvageMult");
2416                }
2417                
2418                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
2419                float valueMultFleet = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.BATTLE_SALVAGE_MULT_FLEET);
2420                float valueModShips = getSalvageValueModPlayerShips();
2421                
2422                
2423                maxSalvageValue *= valueMultFleet + valueModShips;
2424                
2425                creditsLooted = Math.round(maxSalvageValue * creditsFraction);
2426                if (!withCredits) creditsLooted = 0;
2427                maxSalvageValue -= creditsLooted;
2428                
2429                float salvageValue = 0f;
2430                WeightedRandomPicker<String> lootPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
2431                lootPicker.add(Commodities.METALS, 20);
2432                lootPicker.add(Commodities.SUPPLIES, 10);
2433                lootPicker.add(Commodities.FUEL, 10);
2434                lootPicker.add(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, 1);
2435                
2436                while (salvageValue < maxSalvageValue) {
2437                        String commodityId = lootPicker.pick();
2438                        if (commodityId == null) break;
2439                        
2440                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getCommoditySpec(commodityId);
2441                        float qty = 1f;
2442                        salvageValue += spec.getBasePrice() * qty;
2443                        loot.addCommodity(commodityId, qty);
2444                }
2445
2446                
2447                float fuelMult = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.FUEL_SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET);
2448                float fuel = loot.getFuel();
2449                if (fuelMult > 1f) {
2450                        loot.addFuel((int) Math.round(fuel * (fuelMult - 1f)));
2451                }
2452                
2453                if (getBattle().getSnapshotSideFor(loser.getFleet()) == null) return;
2454                
2455                List<DropData> dropRandom = new ArrayList<DropData>();
2456                List<DropData> dropValue = new ArrayList<DropData>();
2457                //for (CampaignFleetAPI other : getBattle().getSideFor(loser.getFleet())) {
2458                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : getBattle().getSnapshotSideFor(loser.getFleet())) {
2459                        dropRandom.addAll(other.getDropRandom());
2460                        dropValue.addAll(other.getDropValue());
2461                        other.getDropRandom().clear();
2462                        other.getDropValue().clear();
2463                        
2464                        CargoAPI extra = BaseSalvageSpecial.getCombinedExtraSalvage(other);
2465                        if (!extra.isEmpty()) {
2466                                loot.addAll(extra);
2467                        }
2468                        
2469                        BaseSalvageSpecial.clearExtraSalvage(other);
2470                        if (!extra.isEmpty()) {
2471                                ListenerUtil.reportExtraSalvageShown(other);
2472                        }
2473                }
2474                
2475                if (forRandomDrops != null) {
2476                        random = forRandomDrops;
2477                }
2478                CargoAPI extra = SalvageEntity.generateSalvage(random, valueMultFleet + valueModShips, 1f, fuelMult, dropValue, dropRandom);
2479                for (CargoStackAPI stack : extra.getStacksCopy()) {
2480                        loot.addFromStack(stack);
2481                }
2482                
2483                if (forCargoDrops != null) {
2484                        salvageRandom = forCargoDrops;
2485                }
2486                handleCargoLooting(recoveredShips, false);
2487                
2488                if (resetSalvageRandomTo != null) {
2489                        salvageRandom = resetSalvageRandomTo;
2490                }
2491        }

2520        protected static class LossFraction {
2521                public float maxCargo;
2522                public float maxFuel;
2523                public float lostCargo;
2524                public float lostFuel;
2525        }
2526        
2527        
2528        protected void handleCargoLooting(List<FleetMemberAPI> recoveredShips, boolean takingFromPlayer) {
2529                DataForEncounterSide winner = getWinnerData();
2530                DataForEncounterSide loser = getLoserData();
2531
2532                if (winner == null || loser == null) return;
2533                
2534                loser.getFleet().getFleetData().updateCargoCapacities();
2535                CargoAPI loserCargo = (CargoAPI) loser.getFleet().getCargo();
2536                float maxCargo = loserCargo.getMaxCapacity();
2537                float maxFuel = loserCargo.getMaxFuel();
2538                
2539                Random random = Misc.random;
2540                if (salvageRandom != null) random = salvageRandom;
2541                
2542//              boolean playerLost = battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(loser.getFleet()));
2543                
2544                Map<CargoAPI, LossFraction> fractions = new HashMap<CargoAPI, LossFraction>();
2545                
2546                float lostCargo = 0f;
2547                float lostFuel = 0f;
2548
2549                float totalLoss = 0f;
2550                for (FleetMemberData data : winner.getEnemyCasualties()) {
2551//                      if (data.getStatus() == Status.REPAIRED) {
2552//                              continue;
2553//                      }
2554//                      if (playerLost && data.getMember().isAlly()) {
2555//                              continue;
2556//                      }
2557                        
2558                        CampaignFleetAPI source = battle.getSourceFleet(data.getMember());
2559                        CampaignFleetAPI orig = origSourceForRecoveredShips.get(data.getMember());
2560                        if (orig != null) source = orig;
2561                        
2562                        if (source != null) {
2563                                CargoAPI c = source.getCargo();
2564                                LossFraction loss = fractions.get(c);
2565                                if (loss == null) {
2566                                        loss = new LossFraction();
2567                                        loss.maxCargo = c.getMaxCapacity();
2568                                        loss.maxFuel = c.getMaxFuel();
2569                                        fractions.put(c, loss);
2570                                }
2571                                
2572                                loss.lostCargo += data.getMember().getCargoCapacity();
2573                                loss.lostFuel += data.getMember().getFuelCapacity();
2574                                
2575                                loss.maxCargo += data.getMember().getCargoCapacity();
2576                                loss.maxFuel += data.getMember().getFuelCapacity();
2577                                
2578                                totalLoss += loss.maxCargo + loss.maxFuel;
2579                        } else {
2580                                lostCargo += data.getMember().getCargoCapacity();
2581                                lostFuel += data.getMember().getFuelCapacity();
2582                                
2583                                maxCargo += data.getMember().getCargoCapacity();
2584                                maxFuel += data.getMember().getFuelCapacity();
2585                                
2586                                totalLoss += maxCargo + maxFuel;
2587                        }
2588                        
2589                }
2590                
2591                //if (lostCargo <= 0 && lostFuel <= 0) {
2592                if (totalLoss <= 0) {
2593                        return;
2594                }
2595                
2596                if (maxCargo < 1) maxCargo = 1;
2597                if (maxFuel < 1) maxFuel = 1;
2598                
2599                float recoveryFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageCargoFraction");
2600                float extraFuelRecoveryFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageFuelFraction");
2601                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
2602                        recoveryFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_salvageCargoFractionPostCombat");
2603                        extraFuelRecoveryFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageFuelFractionPostCombat");
2604                }
2605                
2606                
2607                if (battle.isPlayerSide(battle.getSideFor(winner.getFleet()))) {
2608                        float playerContribMult = computePlayerContribFraction();
2609                        recoveryFraction *= playerContribMult;
2610                        extraFuelRecoveryFraction *= playerContribMult;
2611                }
2612                
2613                float cargoFractionLost = lostCargo / maxCargo;
2614                float fuelFractionLost = lostFuel / maxFuel;
2615                if (lostCargo > maxCargo) cargoFractionLost = 1f;
2616                if (lostFuel > maxFuel) fuelFractionLost = 1f;
2617                
2618                
2619                List<CampaignFleetAPI> losers = battle.getSnapshotSideFor(loser.getFleet());
2620                if (losers == null) return;
2621                
2622                List<LootableCargoStack> stacks = new ArrayList<LootableCargoStack>();
2623                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : losers) {
2624                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : curr.getCargo().getStacksCopy()) {
2625                                stacks.add(new LootableCargoStack(curr.getCargo(), stack));
2626                        }
2627                }
2628                
2629                if (extraFuelRecoveryFraction > 0) {
2630                        float max = 0f;
2631                        float totalFuelLost = 0f;
2632                        for (LossFraction curr : fractions.values()) {
2633                                totalFuelLost += curr.lostFuel;
2634                                max += curr.maxFuel;
2635                        }
2636                        if (max < 1f) max = 1f;
2637                        float fraction = Math.max(totalFuelLost / max, fuelFractionLost);
2638                        int fuel = (int) (Math.max(max, maxFuel) * extraFuelRecoveryFraction * fraction);
2639                        fuel = Math.round(fuel * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f));
2640                        if (fuel > 0) {
2641                                loot.addFuel(fuel);
2642                        }
2643                }
2644                
2645                for (LootableCargoStack stack : stacks) {
2646                        if (stack.stack.isNull()) continue;
2647                        if (stack.stack.isPersonnelStack()) continue;
2648                        if (stack.stack.getSize() < 1) continue;
2649                        
2650                        float actualCargoFractionLost = cargoFractionLost;
2651                        float actualFuelFractionLost = fuelFractionLost;
2652                        LossFraction loss = fractions.get(stack.source);
2653                        if (loss != null) {
2654                                actualCargoFractionLost = loss.lostCargo / loss.maxCargo;
2655                                actualFuelFractionLost = loss.lostFuel / loss.maxFuel;
2656                                if (loss.lostCargo > loss.maxCargo) actualCargoFractionLost = 1f;
2657                                if (loss.lostFuel > loss.maxFuel) actualFuelFractionLost = 1f;
2658                        }
2659                        
2660                        
2661                        if (takingFromPlayer) {
2662                                if (stack.stack.isSpecialStack()) continue;
2663                                if (stack.stack.isCommodityStack()) {
2664                                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = stack.stack.getResourceIfResource();
2665                                        if (spec != null && spec.hasTag(Commodities.TAG_NO_LOSS_FROM_COMBAT)){
2666                                                continue;
2667                                        }
2668                                }
2669                        }
2670                        
2671                        float numLost = 0;
2672                        float numTaken = 0;
2673                        if (stack.stack.isFuelStack()) {
2674                                numLost = actualFuelFractionLost * stack.stack.getSize();
2675                                numTaken = Math.round(numLost * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f));
2676                        } else {
2677                                numLost = actualCargoFractionLost * stack.stack.getSize();
2678                                numTaken = Math.round(numLost * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f));
2679                        }
2680                        
2681                        if (numLost < 1) {
2682                                if (random.nextFloat() < numLost) {
2683                                        numLost = 1;
2684                                } else {
2685                                        numLost = 0;
2686                                        numTaken = 0;
2687                                }
2688                        }
2689                        
2690                        if (numLost <= 0) continue;
2691                        
2692                        stack.stack.add(-numLost);
2693                        if (numTaken * recoveryFraction >= 1) {
2694                                loot.addItems(stack.stack.getType(), stack.stack.getData(), numTaken * recoveryFraction);
2695                        }
2696                }
2697                
2698                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getSideFor(loser.getFleet())) {
2699                        if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
2700                                fleet.getCargo().sort();
2701                                break;
2702                        }
2703                }
2704        }

2711        protected void lootHullMods(FleetMemberAPI member, ShipVariantAPI variant, float mult) {
2712                if (variant == null) return;
2713                if (member.isFighterWing()) return;
2714                Random random = Misc.random;
2715                if (salvageRandom != null) random = salvageRandom;
2716                
2717                //mult *= getNonSalvageResourceMult(member);
2718                
2719                float p = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageHullmodProb");
2720                float pItem = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageHullmodRequiredItemProb");
2721                
2722                for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
2723                        if (!variant.getHullSpec().isBuiltInMod(id)) {
2724                                if (random.nextFloat() < pItem && random.nextFloat() < mult) {
2725                                        HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
2726                                        CargoStackAPI item = spec.getEffect().getRequiredItem();
2727                                        if (item != null) {
2728                                                boolean addToLoot = true;
2729                                                if (item.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial() != null && item.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial().hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) {
2730                                                        addToLoot = false;
2731                                                } else if (item.getResourceIfResource() != null && item.getResourceIfResource().hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) {
2732                                                        addToLoot = false;
2733                                                } else if (item.getFighterWingSpecIfWing() != null && item.getFighterWingSpecIfWing().hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) {
2734                                                        addToLoot = false;
2735                                                } else if (item.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon() != null && item.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon().hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) {
2736                                                        addToLoot = false;
2737                                                }
2738                                                if (addToLoot) {
2739                                                        loot.addItems(item.getType(), item.getData(), 1);
2740                                                }
2741                                        }
2742                                }
2743                        }
2744                        
2745                        //if (random.nextFloat() > mult) continue;
2746                        if (random.nextFloat() < p && random.nextFloat() < mult) {
2747                                HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
2748                                boolean known = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(id);
2749                                if (DebugFlags.ALLOW_KNOWN_HULLMOD_DROPS) known = false;
2750                                if (known || spec.isHidden() || spec.isHiddenEverywhere()) continue;
2751                                //if (spec.isAlwaysUnlocked()) continue;
2752                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NO_DROP)) continue;
2753                                
2754                                loot.addHullmods(id, 1);
2755                        }
2756                }
2757                
2758                for (String slotId : variant.getModuleSlots()) {
2759                        WeaponSlotAPI slot = variant.getSlot(slotId);
2760                        if (slot.isStationModule()) {
2761                                ShipVariantAPI module = variant.getModuleVariant(slotId);
2762                                if (module == null) continue;
2763                                lootHullMods(member, module, mult);
2764                        }
2765                }
2766        }

2932        public void autoLoot() {
2933                DataForEncounterSide winner = getWinnerData();
2934                DataForEncounterSide loser = getLoserData();
2935                if (winner == null || loser == null) return;
2936                
2937                List<CampaignFleetAPI> winners = battle.getSideFor(winner.getFleet());
2938                WeightedRandomPicker<CampaignFleetAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<CampaignFleetAPI>();
2939                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : winners) {
2940                        picker.add(curr, curr.getFleetPoints());
2941                }
2942                for (CargoStackAPI stack : loot.getStacksCopy()) {
2943                        if (stack.isNull() || stack.isFuelStack()) continue;
2944                        
2945                        CampaignFleetAPI pick = picker.pick();
2946                        if (pick == null) break;
2947                        
2948                        CargoAPI winnerCargo = pick.getCargo();
2949                        float spaceLeft = winnerCargo.getSpaceLeft();
2950                        if (spaceLeft <= 0) {
2951                                picker.remove(pick);
2952                                continue;
2953                        }
2954                        
2955                        float spacePerUnit = stack.getCargoSpacePerUnit();
2956                        float maxUnits = (int) (spaceLeft / spacePerUnit);
2957                        if (maxUnits > stack.getSize()) maxUnits = stack.getSize();
2958                        maxUnits = Math.round(maxUnits * (Math.random() * 0.5f + 0.5f));
2959                        winnerCargo.addItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), maxUnits);
2960                }
2961                
2962                picker.clear();
2963                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : winners) {
2964                        picker.add(curr, curr.getFleetPoints());
2965                }
2966                for (CargoStackAPI stack : loot.getStacksCopy()) {
2967                        if (stack.isNull() || !stack.isFuelStack()) continue;
2968                        
2969                        CampaignFleetAPI pick = picker.pick();
2970                        if (pick == null) break;
2971                        
2972                        CargoAPI winnerCargo = pick.getCargo();
2973                        float spaceLeft = winnerCargo.getMaxCapacity() - winnerCargo.getFuel();
2974                        if (spaceLeft <= 0) {
2975                                picker.remove(pick);
2976                                continue;
2977                        }
2978                        
2979                        float spacePerUnit = stack.getCargoSpacePerUnit();
2980                        float maxUnits = (int) (spaceLeft / spacePerUnit);
2981                        if (maxUnits > stack.getSize()) maxUnits = stack.getSize();
2982                        maxUnits = Math.round(maxUnits * (Math.random() * 0.5f + 0.5f));
2983                        winnerCargo.addItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), maxUnits);
2984                }
2985        }

3012        public void fixFighters(EngagementResultForFleetAPI result) {
3013                Set<CampaignFleetAPI> fleetsWithDecks = new HashSet<CampaignFleetAPI>();
3014                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : result.getReserves()) {
3015                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(curr) == null) continue;
3016                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
3017                        if (curr.getNumFlightDecks() > 0) {
3018                                fleetsWithDecks.add(battle.getSourceFleet(curr));
3019                        }
3020                }
3021                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : result.getDeployed()) {
3022                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(curr) == null) continue;
3023                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
3024                        if (curr.getNumFlightDecks() > 0) {
3025                                fleetsWithDecks.add(battle.getSourceFleet(curr));
3026                        }
3027                }
3028                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : result.getRetreated()) {
3029                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(curr) == null) continue;
3030                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
3031                        if (curr.getNumFlightDecks() > 0) {
3032                                fleetsWithDecks.add(battle.getSourceFleet(curr));
3033                        }
3034                }
3035                
3036                List<FleetMemberAPI> saved = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
3037                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : result.getDestroyed()) {
3038                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(curr) == null) continue;
3039                        if (!fleetsWithDecks.contains(battle.getSourceFleet(curr))) continue;
3040                        if (curr.isFighterWing()) {
3041                                saved.add(curr);
3042                        }
3043                }
3044                
3045                result.getDestroyed().removeAll(saved);
3046                result.getRetreated().addAll(saved);
3047                
3048                
3049                List<FleetMemberAPI> toRepair = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
3050                toRepair.addAll(result.getDeployed());
3051                toRepair.addAll(result.getRetreated());
3052                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : toRepair) {
3053                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(curr) == null) continue;
3054                        if (curr.isFighterWing()) {
3055                                if (fleetsWithDecks.contains(battle.getSourceFleet(curr))) {
3056                                        curr.getStatus().repairFully();
3057                                } else {
3058                                        curr.getStatus().repairFullyNoNewFighters();
3059                                }
3060                        }
3061                }
3062                
3063        }

3091                boolean wonBattle = result.isWinner();
3092                if (wonBattle) {
3093                        preEngagementCRForWinner.clear();
3094                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.getFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
3095                                preEngagementCRForWinner.put(member, member.getRepairTracker().getCR());
3096                        }
3097                }
3098                
3099                List<FleetMemberAPI> applyDeployCostTo = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>(result.getDeployed());
3100                
3101                for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.getDisabled()) {
3102                        // does not work, needs more things changed to work
3103                        //float mult = member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.CR_LOSS_WHEN_DISABLED_MULT);
3104                        float mult = 1f;
3105                        if (mult > 0) {
3106                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-1f * mult, "disabled in combat");
3107                        }
3108                        if (mult < 1) {
3109                                applyDeployCostTo.add(member);
3110                        }
3111                        
3112                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
3113                        if (dfm != null) {
3114                                float deployCost = getDeployCost(member);
3115                                float endOfCombatCR = dfm.getShip().getCurrentCR() - deployCost;
3116                                member.getRepairTracker().setCrWhenDisabledOrDestroyed(endOfCombatCR);
3117                        }
3118                }
3119                for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.getDestroyed()) {
3120//                      if (member.getHullId().equals("vanguard_pirates")) {
3121//                              System.out.println("efwefwef");
3122//                      }
3123                        //float mult = member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.CR_LOSS_WHEN_DISABLED_MULT);
3124                        float mult = 1f;
3125                        if (mult > 0) {
3126                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-1f * mult, "disabled in combat");
3127                        }
3128                        if (mult < 1) {
3129                                applyDeployCostTo.add(member);
3130                        }
3131                        
3132                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);

3138                }
3139                
3140                for (FleetMemberAPI member : applyDeployCostTo) {
3141                        float deployCost = getDeployCost(member);
3142                        if (member.isFighterWing()) {
3143                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-deployCost, "wing deployed in combat");
3144                        } else {
3145                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-deployCost, "deployed in combat");
3146                        }

3150                        if (combatPay > 0) {
3151                                accruedCombatPay += combatPay;

3154                        applyExtendedCRLossIfNeeded(result, member);

3156                        if (member.getOwner() == 0 && !member.isAlly()) {
3157                                ListenerUtil.appliedPostCombatCRLossToFleetMember(member);

3159                }
3160                
3161                //float retreatLossMult = StarfarerSettings.getCRLossMultForRetreatInLoss();
3162                float retreatLossMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("crLossMultForRetreatInLoss");
3163                for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.getRetreated()) {
3164                        float deployCost = getDeployCost(member);
3165                        if (member.isFighterWing()) {
3166                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-deployCost, "wing deployed in combat");

3175                        }
3176                        
3177                        applyExtendedCRLossIfNeeded(result, member);
3178                        
3179                        if (!wonBattle && result.getGoal() != FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
3180                                float retreatCost = deployCost * retreatLossMult;
3181                                if (retreatCost > 0) {
3182                                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-retreatCost, "retreated from lost engagement");
3183                                }
3184                        }
3185                        
3186                        if (member.getOwner() == 0 && !member.isAlly()) {
3187                                ListenerUtil.appliedPostCombatCRLossToFleetMember(member);
3188                        }
3189                }
3190                
3191//              // important, so that in-combat Ship objects can be garbage collected.
3192//              // Probably some combat engine references in there, too. 
3193//              // NOTE: moved this elsewhere in this class
3194//              result.resetAllEverDeployed();
3195//              getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().clear();
3196        }

3210        /**
3211         * Only matters in non-auto-resolved battles.
3212         * @param member
3213         */
3214        protected void applyExtendedCRLossIfNeeded(EngagementResultForFleetAPI result, FleetMemberAPI member) {
3215                DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
3216                if (dfm == null) return;
3217                
3218                if (battle != null && battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) {
3219                        return;
3220                }
3221                if (member.getFleetCommander() == null) {
3222                        return;
3223                }
3224                
3225                if (dfm.getMember() == member && dfm.isFighterWing()) {
3226                        //float finalCR = dfm.getShip().getRemainingWingCR();
3227                        float cr = member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR();
3228                        float finalCR = cr;
3229                        if (cr > finalCR) {
3230                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-(cr - finalCR), "deployed replacement chassis in combat");
3231                        }
3232                        return;
3233                }
3234                if (dfm.getMember() == member && !dfm.isFighterWing()) {
3235                        float deployCost = getDeployCost(member);
3236                        float endOfCombatCR = dfm.getShip().getCurrentCR() - deployCost;
3237                        float cr = member.getRepairTracker().getCR();
3238                        if (cr > endOfCombatCR) {
3239                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-(cr - endOfCombatCR), "extended deployment");
3240                        }
3241                        
3242                        ShipAPI ship = dfm.getShip();
3243                        if (dfm.getShip() != null && !dfm.isFighterWing()) {
3244                                float wMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("crLossMultForWeaponDisabled");
3245                                float eMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("crLossMultForFlameout");
3246                                float mMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("crLossMultForMissilesFired");
3247                                float hMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("crLossMultForHullDamage");
3248                                
3249                                float hullDamageFraction = ship.getHullLevelAtDeployment() - ship.getLowestHullLevelReached();
3250                                float hullDamageCRLoss = hullDamageFraction * hMult;
3251                                hullDamageCRLoss *= ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.HULL_DAMAGE_CR_LOSS);
3252                                if (hullDamageCRLoss > 0) {
3253                                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-hullDamageCRLoss, "hull damage sustained");
3254                                }
3255                                
3256                                member.getStatus().setHullFraction(ship.getLowestHullLevelReached());
3257                                
3258                                
3259                                float instaRepairFraction = member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.INSTA_REPAIR_FRACTION, 0f);
3260                                if (instaRepairFraction > 0) {
3261                                        float hullDamage = member.getStatus().getHullDamageTaken();
3262                                        float armorDamage = member.getStatus().getArmorDamageTaken();
3263                                        
3264                                        member.getStatus().repairArmorAllCells(armorDamage * instaRepairFraction); 
3265                                        member.getStatus().repairHullFraction(hullDamage * instaRepairFraction); 
3266                                }
3267                                
3268                                
3269                                float totalDisabled = 0f;
3270                                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = member.getFleetCommander().getStats();
3271                                float maxOP = ship.getVariant().getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
3272                                if (maxOP <= 1) maxOP = 1;
3273                                
3274                                for (WeaponAPI w : ship.getDisabledWeapons()) {
3275                                        totalDisabled += w.getSpec().getOrdnancePointCost(stats, ship.getVariant().getStatsForOpCosts()) * wMult;
3276                                }
3277                                if (ship.getNumFlameouts() > 0) {
3278                                        totalDisabled += maxOP * eMult;
3279                                }
3280                                
3281                                float damageBasedCRLoss = Math.min(1f, totalDisabled / maxOP);
3282                                if (damageBasedCRLoss > 0) {
3283                                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-damageBasedCRLoss, "weapon and engine damage sustained");
3284                                }
3285                                
3286                                float missileReloadOP = 0f;
3287                                for (WeaponAPI w : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
3288                                        if (w.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE && w.usesAmmo()) {
3289                                                missileReloadOP += (1f - (float) w.getAmmo() / (float) w.getMaxAmmo()) * w.getSpec().getOrdnancePointCost(stats, ship.getVariant().getStatsForOpCosts()) * mMult;
3290                                        }
3291                                }
3292                                
3293                                float missileReloadLoss = Math.min(1f, missileReloadOP / maxOP);
3294                                if (missileReloadLoss > 0) {
3295                                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-missileReloadLoss, "missile weapons used in combat");
3296                                }
3297                        }
3298                        
3299                        return;
3300                }
3301        }

3330        public static class CrewLossFraction {
3331                public float total;
3332                public float notFromFighters;
3333                public float fromFighters;
3334                public CrewLossFraction(float total) {
3335                        this.total = total;
3336                }
3337                public CrewLossFraction(float total, float fromFighters) {
3338                        this.total = total;
3339                        this.fromFighters = fromFighters;
3340                        if (total > 1f) {
3341                                this.notFromFighters = (total - fromFighters) / total;
3342                                this.fromFighters = fromFighters / total;
3343                        }
3344                }
3345        }
3346        
3347        protected CrewLossFraction computeLossFraction(FleetMemberAPI member, EngagementResultForFleetAPI result, float hullFraction, float hullDamage) {
3348                if (hullFraction < 0) hullFraction = 0;
3349                if (member == null && hullFraction == 0) {
3350                        return new CrewLossFraction(0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f);
3351                }
3352                
3353                // unused as fighter wings are LPCs now etc
3354                if (member.isFighterWing() && result != null) {
3355                        //System.out.println("Fighter hullDamage: " + hullDamage);
3356                        float extraLossMult = hullDamage;
3357                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
3358                        if (dfm != null && dfm.getMember() == member) {
3359                                //float finalCR = dfm.getShip().getRemainingWingCR();
3360                                float cr = member.getRepairTracker().getCR();
3361                                float finalCR = cr;
3362                                if (cr > finalCR) {
3363                                        float crPer = dfm.getMember().getStats().getCRPerDeploymentPercent().computeEffective(dfm.getMember().getVariant().getHullSpec().getCRToDeploy()) / 100f;
3364                                        float extraCraftLost = (cr - finalCR) / crPer;
3365                                        float wingSize = dfm.getMember().getNumFightersInWing();
3366                                        if (extraCraftLost >= 1) {
3367                                                extraLossMult = hullDamage + extraCraftLost / wingSize;
3368                                        }
3369                                }
3370                        }
3371                        return new CrewLossFraction((0.25f + (float) Math.random() * 0.75f * (float) Math.random()) * member.getStats().getCrewLossMult().getModifiedValue() * extraLossMult);
3372                }
3373                
3374                float extraFromFighters = 0f;
3375                if (!member.isFighterWing() && result != null) {
3376                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
3377                        if (dfm != null && dfm.getMember() == member) {
3378                                float craftCrewLoss = 0;
3379                                for (FighterLaunchBayAPI bay : dfm.getShip().getLaunchBaysCopy()) {
3380                                        if (bay.getWing() == null || bay.getWing().getLeader() == null) continue;
3381                                        float baseCrew = bay.getWing().getLeader().getHullSpec().getMinCrew();
3382                                        float perCraft = bay.getWing().getLeader().getMutableStats().getMinCrewMod().computeEffective(baseCrew);
3383                                        perCraft *= bay.getWing().getLeader().getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.FIGHTER_CREW_LOSS_MULT);
3384                                        craftCrewLoss += perCraft * bay.getNumLost();
3385                                }
3386                                
3387                                float baseLossFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("fighterCrewLossBase");
3388                                craftCrewLoss *= baseLossFraction;
3389                                
3390                                float memberCrew = member.getMinCrew();
3391                                if (memberCrew > 0) {
3392                                        float threshold = memberCrew * 0.33f;
3393                                        
3394                                        float actualLost = 0f;
3395                                        float mult = 1f;
3396                                        do {
3397                                                float curr = Math.min(craftCrewLoss, threshold);
3398                                                craftCrewLoss -= curr;
3399                                                
3400                                                curr *= mult;
3401                                                actualLost += curr;
3402                                                mult /= 2f;
3403                                                
3404                                        } while (craftCrewLoss > 0);
3405                                        
3406                                        extraFromFighters = actualLost / memberCrew;
3407                                        extraFromFighters *= member.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.FIGHTER_CREW_LOSS_MULT);
3408                                }
3409                        }
3410                }
3411                
3412                float extraFromSOTypeStuff = 0f;
3413                DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm = getDataFor(result.getFleet()).getMemberToDeployedMap().get(member);
3414                float soFactor = member.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SAFETY_OVERRIDES_CREW_LOSS_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
3415                if (dfm != null && dfm.getShip() != null && soFactor > 0) {
3416                        ShipAPI ship = dfm.getShip();
3417                        float peakTimeSpent = ship.getTimeDeployedForCRReduction();
3418                        float noLossTime = ship.getMutableStats().getPeakCRDuration().computeEffective(ship.getHullSpec().getNoCRLossTime());
3419                        
3420                        if (noLossTime > 0 && noLossTime < 10000) {
3421                                float f = peakTimeSpent / noLossTime;
3422                                extraFromSOTypeStuff = f * soFactor;
3423                                extraFromSOTypeStuff *= 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f;
3424                                extraFromSOTypeStuff *= member.getStats().getCrewLossMult().getModifiedValue();
3425                        }
3426                }
3427                
3428                // baseline crew loss fraction, including from fighters, can't be >1
3429                // handled in CrewLossFraction constructor
3430                if (hullFraction == 0) {
3431                        return new CrewLossFraction((0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f) * 
3432                                                        member.getStats().getCrewLossMult().getModifiedValue() + extraFromFighters + extraFromSOTypeStuff, extraFromFighters); 
3433                }
3434                return new CrewLossFraction(hullDamage * hullDamage * (0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f) * 
3435                                                        member.getStats().getCrewLossMult().getModifiedValue() + extraFromFighters + extraFromSOTypeStuff, extraFromFighters);
3436        }

3441//              float f = 1f - computeLossFraction(member, result, hullFraction, hullDamage);
3442//              if (f < 0) f = 0;
3443//              return f;
3444//      }
