3446        public void calculateAndApplyCrewLosses(EngagementResultForFleetAPI result, boolean playerInvolved) {
3447                boolean wonBattle = result.isWinner(); 
3448                
3449                DataForEncounterSide data = getDataFor(result.getFleet());
3450                CrewCompositionAPI recoverable = data.getRecoverableCrewLosses();
3451                //recoverable.removeAllCrew();
3452                
3453                List<FleetMemberAPI> all = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
3454                all.addAll(result.getDisabled());
3455                all.addAll(result.getDeployed());
3456                all.addAll(result.getDestroyed());
3457                all.addAll(result.getRetreated());
3458                all.addAll(result.getReserves());
3459                
3460                for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.getReserves()) {
3461                        member.getStatus().resetDamageTaken();
3462                }
3463                
3464                CrewCompositionAPI playerLosses = data.getCrewLossesDuringLastEngagement();
3465                playerLosses.removeAllCrew();
3466
3467                CrewCompositionAPI crewLosses = Global.getFactory().createCrewComposition();
3468                crewLosses.removeAllCrew();
3469                
3470                int recoverablePlayerFighterLosses = RecoveryShuttles.getFighterPilotsRecoveredForPlayerShips();
3471                float maxExtraRecoverableFighterLossFraction = RecoveryShuttles.MAX_RECOVERED;
3472                
3473                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = null;
3474                //float maxExtraLoss = 0f;
3475                float playerCapacityLost = 0f;
3476                for (FleetMemberAPI member : all) {
3477                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) == null) continue;
3478                        boolean player = battle.getSourceFleet(member) != null && battle.getSourceFleet(member).isPlayerFleet();
3479                        CrewCompositionAPI c = member.getCrewComposition();
3480                        //float hull = member.getStatus().getHullFraction();
3481                        float hullDamage = member.getStatus().getHullDamageTaken();
3482                        float hullFraction = member.getStatus().getHullFraction();
3483                        member.getStatus().resetDamageTaken();
3484                        
3485                        //if (hullDamage > 0 && !result.getFleet().isPlayerFleet() && playerInvolved) {
3486//                      if (hullDamage > 0 && playerInvolved &&
3487//                                      !battle.getPlayerSide().contains(battle.getSourceFleet(member))) {
3488//                              playerDidSeriousDamage = true;
3489//                      }
3490//                      if (lostBattle) {
3491//                              System.out.println("HERE");
3492//                      }
3493                        
3494                        CrewLossFraction clf = computeLossFraction(member, result, hullFraction, hullDamage);
3495                        float fLost = clf.total;
3496                        float fromFighters = clf.fromFighters;
3497                        
3498                        if (player && recoverablePlayerFighterLosses > 0 && fromFighters > 0f) {
3499                                int lostPilots = (int) (fromFighters * c.getCrew());
3500                                int recoverPilots = (int) Math.min(lostPilots * maxExtraRecoverableFighterLossFraction, recoverablePlayerFighterLosses);
3501                                recoverablePlayerFighterLosses -= recoverPilots;
3502                                recoverable.addCrew(recoverPilots);
3503                        }
3504                        
3505                        // ship is disabled or destroyed, lose all crew for now, but it may be recovered later
3506                        if (result.getDisabled().contains(member) || result.getDestroyed().contains(member)) {
3507                                if (playerInvolved &&
3508                                                !battle.getPlayerSide().contains(battle.getSourceFleet(member))) {
3509                                        playerDidSeriousDamage = true;
3510                                }
3511                                if (player) {
3512                                        if (fLost < 1) {
3513                                                recoverable.addCrew((1f - fLost) * c.getCrew());
3514                                        }
3515                                        playerLosses.addCrew(c.getCrew() * 1f);
3516                                        playerCapacityLost += member.getMaxCrew();
3517                                }
3518
3519                                crewLosses.addCrew(c.getCrew() * 1f);
3520                                c.setCrew(0);
3521                                //c.addCrew(-c.getCrew() * f1);
3522                                // c should now be left with the appropriate crew composition (base minus losses) to use
3523                                // as a starting point for boarding actions
3524                                
3525                        } else {
3526                                // the ship is still ok, only lose the non-recoverable casualties
3527                                
3528                                // for fighters, which can lose more than their actual max crew 
3529                                if (fLost > 1) {
3530                                        crewLosses.addCrew((fLost - 1) * c.getCrew());
3531                                }
3532                                
3533                                float lost = c.getCrew() * fLost;
3534                                // both fighters and normal ships
3535                                c.transfer(lost, crewLosses);
3536                                
3537                                if (player) {
3538                                        playerLosses.addCrew(lost);
3539                                        playerCapacityLost += member.getMaxCrew() * fLost;
3540                                }
3541                        }
3542                        
3543                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member).isPlayerFleet() && 
3544                                        (crewLosses.getCrew() > 0 || crewLosses.getMarines() > 0)) {
3545                                playerFleet = battle.getSourceFleet(member);
3546                        }
3547                        
3548                        CargoAPI cargo = battle.getSourceFleet(member).getCargo();
3549                        cargo.removeItems(CargoAPI.CargoItemType.RESOURCES, Commodities.CREW, (int)crewLosses.getCrew());
3550                        cargo.removeMarines((int) crewLosses.getMarines());
3551                        crewLosses.clear();
3552                }
3553                
3554                // lose over-capacity crew
3555                if (playerFleet != null) {
3556                        playerFleet.getFleetData().updateCargoCapacities();
3557                        CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
3558                        float maxCrew = cargo.getMaxPersonnel();
3559                        float totalCrew = cargo.getTotalCrew();
3560                        float marines = cargo.getMarines();
3561                        float recoverableTotal = recoverable.getCrew() + recoverable.getMarines();
3562                        
3563                        //recoverableTotal = 0f; // uncomment to let recoverable crew not be lost due to being over capacity
3564                        
3565                        float total = totalCrew + marines + recoverableTotal;
3566                        if (maxCrew + playerCapacityLost > 0) {
3567                                total *= playerCapacityLost / (maxCrew + playerCapacityLost);
3568                        }
3569//                      if (!wonBattle) {
3570//                              total = totalCrew + marines;
3571//                              recoverableTotal = 0f;
3572//                      }
3573                        //if (total > playerOvercapLosses) total = playerOvercapLosses;
3574                        if (total > maxCrew) {
3575                                //float toLose = Math.min(maxExtraLoss, total - maxCrew);
3576                                float toLose = total - maxCrew;
3577                                if (toLose > 0) {
3578                                        //recoverable.clear();
3579                                        recoverable.transfer(Math.min(recoverableTotal, toLose), null);
3580                                        toLose -= recoverableTotal;
3581                                        total -= recoverableTotal;
3582                                        
3583                                        if (toLose > 0 && total > 0) {
3584                                                float crew = cargo.getCrew(); // this is 99% the same as totalCrew, but leaving as is for now
3585        
3586                                                crewLosses.clear();
3587                                                crewLosses.addCrew((int)Math.ceil(crew / total * toLose));
3588                                                crewLosses.addMarines((int)Math.ceil(marines / total * toLose));
3589                                                
3590                                                playerLosses.addCrew(crewLosses.getCrew() * 1f);
3591                                                playerLosses.addMarines(crewLosses.getMarines() * 1f);
3592                                                
3593                                                cargo.removeItems(CargoAPI.CargoItemType.RESOURCES, Commodities.CREW, (int)crewLosses.getCrew());
3594                                                cargo.removeMarines((int) crewLosses.getMarines());
3595                                                crewLosses.clear();
3596                                        }
3597                                }
3598                        }
3599                }
3600                
3601        }

3635        protected float difficulty = 1f;
3636        protected boolean computedDifficulty = false;
3637        public float computeBattleDifficulty() {
3638                if (computedDifficulty) return difficulty;
3639                
3640                computedDifficulty = true;
3641                if (battle == null || !battle.isPlayerInvolved()) {
3642                        difficulty = 1f;
3643                        return difficulty;
3644                }
3645                
3646                float scorePlayer = 0f;
3647                float scoreEnemy = 0f;
3648                
3649                float officerBase = 30;
3650                float officerPerLevel = 15; 
3651                //float baseMult = 0.2f;
3652                float baseMult = 2f;
3653                float dModMult = 0.9f;
3654                
3655                for (FleetMemberAPI member : battle.getNonPlayerCombined().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
3656                        if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
3657                        float mult = baseMult;
3658                        if (member.isStation()) mult *= 1f;
3659                        else if (member.isCivilian()) mult *= 0.25f;
3660                        if (member.getCaptain() != null && !member.getCaptain().isDefault()) {
3661                                scoreEnemy += officerBase + officerPerLevel * Math.max(1f, member.getCaptain().getStats().getLevel());
3662                        }
3663                        int dMods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
3664                        for (int i = 0; i < dMods; i++) {
3665                                mult *= dModMult;
3666                        }
3667//                      String prefix = "battle_difficulty_mult_";
3668//                      for (String tag : member.getHullSpec().getTags()) {
3669//                              if (tag.startsWith(prefix)) {
3670//                                      tag = tag.replaceFirst(prefix, "");
3671//                                      mult *= Float.parseFloat(tag);
3672//                                      break;
3673//                              }
3674//                      }
3675                        //scoreEnemy += member.getUnmodifiedDeploymentPointsCost() * mult;
3676                        scoreEnemy += member.getFleetPointCost() * mult;
3677                }
3678                scoreEnemy *= 0.6f;
3679                
3680                float maxPlayserShipScore = 0f;
3681                
3682                officerBase *= 0.5f;
3683                officerPerLevel *= 0.5f;
3684                Set<PersonAPI> seenOfficers = new HashSet<PersonAPI>();
3685                int unofficeredShips = 0;
3686                for (FleetMemberAPI member : battle.getPlayerCombined().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
3687                        if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
3688                        float mult = baseMult;
3689                        if (member.isStation()) mult *= 1f;
3690                        else if (member.isCivilian()) mult *= 0.25f;
3691                        if (member.getCaptain() != null && !member.getCaptain().isDefault()) {
3692                                scorePlayer += officerBase + officerPerLevel * Math.max(1f, member.getCaptain().getStats().getLevel());
3693                                seenOfficers.add(member.getCaptain());
3694                        } else if (!member.isCivilian()) {
3695                                unofficeredShips++;
3696                        }
3697                        int dMods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
3698                        for (int i = 0; i < dMods; i++) {
3699                                mult *= dModMult;
3700                        }
3701                        //float currShipBaseScore = member.getUnmodifiedDeploymentPointsCost() * mult;
3702                        float currShipBaseScore = member.getFleetPointCost() * mult;
3703                        scorePlayer += currShipBaseScore;
3704                        if (battle.getSourceFleet(member) != null && battle.getSourceFleet(member).isPlayerFleet()) {
3705                                maxPlayserShipScore = Math.max(maxPlayserShipScore, currShipBaseScore);
3706                        }
3707                }
3708                
3709                // so that removing officers from ships prior to a fight doesn't increase the XP gained
3710                // otherwise would usually be optimal to do this prior to every fight for any officers 
3711                // on ships that aren't expected to be deployed
3712                for (OfficerDataAPI od : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
3713                        if (seenOfficers.contains(od.getPerson())) continue;
3714                        if (od.getPerson().isPlayer()) continue;
3715                        if (!od.isActivated()) continue;
3716                        if (unofficeredShips <= 0) break;
3717                        unofficeredShips--;
3718                        scorePlayer += officerBase + officerPerLevel * Math.max(1f, od.getPerson().getStats().getLevel());
3719                }
3720        
3721                scorePlayer = Math.max(scorePlayer, Math.min(scoreEnemy * 0.5f, maxPlayserShipScore * 6f));
3722                
3723                if (scorePlayer < 1) scorePlayer = 1;
3724                if (scoreEnemy < 1) scoreEnemy = 1;
3725                
3726                
3727//              difficulty = scoreEnemy / (scorePlayer + scoreEnemy);
3728//              if (difficulty > 1) difficulty = 1;
3729//              if (scorePlayer < scoreEnemy) {
3730//                      difficulty *= MAX_XP_MULT;
3731//              }
3732                //difficulty = scoreEnemy / (1f * scorePlayer);
3733                difficulty = scoreEnemy / scorePlayer;
3734                if (difficulty < 0) difficulty = 0;
3735                if (difficulty > MAX_XP_MULT) difficulty = MAX_XP_MULT;
3736                return difficulty;
3737        }
3738}
